In Paris, a couple won medals on the same night: Saya Sakakibara took women's gold and Romain Mahieu took men's bronze. If both make their teams, the San Fernando Valley could offer a sequel.

France swept the men's podium at home, so the question now is who can stop a repeat. On the women's side, Bethany Shriever arrives as a four-time world champion, with Sakakibara and Laura Smulders close behind.

Semifinals thin the field in the heat of late morning. Then the finals arrive: eight riders, one gate, under a minute of chaos. You will barely have time to exhale before the medals are decided.

BOX01.blurb:
A theater built for award shows is about to host a fight. Peacock Theater seats about 7,100, all facing one raised ring on a stage, so the whole room looks the same way instead of circling the action. Boxing's return to the Games starts here at noon.

The early money is on the heavies. The +90kg round of 16 could bring Kazakhstan's Aibek Oralbay, the 2025 world champion, to the ring, and Bakhodir Jalolov's path back is the question hanging over the division.

The round-of-32 bouts at 54kg, 60kg, 65kg and 55kg are the discovery. One loss ends a tournament, so you see who is nervous and who is not.

Saturday night, and the ring lights do more work than they did at noon. By the evening session the novelty has worn off, the Peacock Theater crowd knows when to roar, and the fighters who have waited all day finally get their turn.

The name that could draw the biggest noise is Lin Yu-ting. She said she had considered quitting after the Paris 2024 gender row, then won a second straight Asian Games title at 60kg in 2026. If she qualifies at that weight, every round-of-32 bout she fights is a story in itself.

Elsewhere, a deep +90kg round of 16 is the place to see how heavy the hitters are.

Wu Yu has a number next to her name that nobody else wants: world number one at 51kg. The Paris 2024 flyweight champion won the 2026 Asian Championships and the Asian Games, and she could start her defence in this Sunday lunchtime session.

India's Nikhat Zareen, a two-time world champion, would be a hard draw for anyone. The same card brings a 70kg women's round of 16, men's 60kg and 70kg round-of-32 bouts and the 90kg round of 16.

Sunday noon in downtown LA is a good slot. Sit in the lower tiers and you are looking straight at the ring, with a clean view of every exchange.

The Sunday night session runs past ten o'clock, and by then every fighter knows what a loss costs. Round-of-32 bouts are the last chance for a boxer with a bad draw to cause trouble.

The 90kg round of 16 is where the big moves usually happen. Uzbekistan's Turabek Khabibullaev, the reigning world champion, beat India's Kapil Pokhariya on his way to Asian Games gold in 2026. Anyone who draws him will see why.

In the women's 51kg pool, Wu Yu and the Philippines' Aira Villegas, a Paris 2024 bronze medalist, are the names to remember. Down the hall is a Metro station if the finish runs late.

Two Paris 2024 champions, one weight class, one draw that could keep them apart or throw them together. Lin Yu-ting and Kellie Harrington both competed at 60kg in 2026, and both have said they want to be here.

Harrington came out of retirement, won her 12th Irish elite title in January 2026, and has told people she will try to qualify. Lin, 30, said after her Asian Games win that she is looking toward 2028.

The round of 16 is the moment where a seed can fall. Win and you are one fight from a guaranteed bronze. The men's 55kg and 65kg bouts bring a lot of Uzbek and Japanese talent into the same ring.

Harrington is one of three women to retain a Games boxing title, alongside Nicola Adams and Claressa Shields. A third straight gold would put her in rarer company. Lin won Asian Games gold at 57kg in 2023 and again at 60kg in 2026.

It is a round of 16, so a loss is final. The men's 55kg and 65kg bouts fill out the evening, and Japan's Rui Yamaguchi and the Philippines' Carlo Paalam are the names to follow.

Three men have won three Games boxing golds: Laszlo Papp, Teofilo Stevenson and Felix Savon. Whether Bakhodir Jalolov is chasing them has not been confirmed, but the +90kg quarterfinals in this session are where the question would start to matter.

The prize for winning is immediate. Each weight class awards two bronzes, so a quarterfinal victory guarantees a medal. Expect heavy punches to be thrown by men who know that.

On the women's side, 54kg and 57kg bring World champions in the same corner of the draw. Lunch-hour boxing at Peacock Theater suits that kind of drama.

There is a moment in every quarterfinal when someone realizes they have a medal. In the +90kg bouts tonight, that realization lands on the biggest men in the building.

Jalolov's last fight, a unanimous decision over Solomon Dacres in London, included a fifth-round knockdown. Whoever faces him, if he comes, will see that power up close. India's Narender Berwal has won two straight Asian Games bronzes and lost to Oralbay 5-0 in 2026.

Kazakhstan's Alua Balkibekova won the 2025 title 5-0 over Turkey's Buse Naz Cakiroglu, while China's Wu Yu, the Paris 2024 champion, was ranked first by World Boxing ahead of the 2026 Asian Games.

Oralbay, the 2025 world champion, beat Uzbekistan's Jakhongir Zokirov for 2026 Asian Games gold. Jalolov, if he is here, adds a third-gold story on top of that.

potentialContenders.name: Bakhodir Jalolov
potentialContenders.note: Beat Ayoub Ghadfa for Paris 2024 gold and beat Solomon Dacres as a pro in October 2026. His 2028 plans are unconfirmed.

potentialContenders.name: Arundhati Choudhary
potentialContenders.note: 2026 Asian Championships 70kg gold medalist. Could be a medal threat at 70kg.

potentialContenders.name: Huang Hsiao-wen
potentialContenders.note: Two-time world champion and Paris 2024 bronze medalist, who won 54kg gold at the 2025 World Boxing Championships.

potentialContenders.name: Wu Yu
potentialContenders.note: Paris 2024 flyweight champion and 2026 Asian Games 51kg champion. Likely contender.

BOX16.blurb:
Two Games, two super-heavyweight golds, and a professional record without a loss. If Bakhodir Jalolov defends again (his 2028 plans are unconfirmed), the +90kg semifinal is where a Saturday-night crowd gets its closest look at him.

The rest of the card is all knockout math. Women's 51kg, 54kg and 65kg quarterfinals and men's 60kg and 70kg quarterfinals send one boxer home and one forward each time. At women's 70kg and men's +90kg, even the semifinal losers leave with bronze.

The Peacock Theater usually hosts the Emmys and the ESPYs. Here, roughly 7,100 seats in tiers all face one raised ring, so every row looks straight at the action.
BOX16.potentialContendersIntro: The marquee bouts are the men's +90kg semifinals and the women's 54kg and 65kg quarterfinals. Everything below is projection, since 2028 qualification runs until May 2028.

potentialContenders.name: Bakhodir Jalolov
potentialContenders.note: Won super-heavyweight gold at consecutive Games, including Paris 2024 over Spain's Ayoub Ghadfa. Unbeaten as a pro, but his 2028 plans are unconfirmed, so treat him as a possible entrant.

potentialContenders.name: Aibek Oralbay
potentialContenders.note: Won +90kg gold at the 2026 Asian Games after a 5-0 semifinal win over India's Narender Berwal. A likely contender to reach the final four if he qualifies.

potentialContenders.name: Jakhongir Zokirov
potentialContenders.note: Took +90kg silver at the 2026 Asian Games. He could be Uzbekistan's alternative if Jalolov doesn't compete.

potentialContenders.name: Preeti
potentialContenders.note: Won women's 54kg at both the 2026 Asian Championships and the 2026 Commonwealth Games. A projected medal threat if she makes India's team.

potentialContenders.name: Aida Abikeyeva
potentialContenders.note: Won women's 65kg gold at the 2025 World Boxing Championships, beating Uzbekistan's Navbakhor Khamidova in the final. A likely title favorite if she qualifies.

BOX17.blurb:
A world final from 2025 could replay at noon on Sunday. India's Jaismine Lamboria beat Poland's Julia Szeremeta 4-1 for the 57kg world title, and Szeremeta is the Paris 2024 silver medalist. Both are projected contenders at 57kg in 2028, and a quarterfinal win here guarantees at least a bronze.

The 75kg quarterfinals carry the same stakes. Lovlina Borgohain, Aoife O'Rourke and Paris champion Li Qian are the names to circle, if each qualifies. Then the men's 55kg semifinals decide who fights for gold, with Japan's Rui Yamaguchi and Uzbekistan's Samandar Olimov among the likely hopefuls.

The session ends at 2:35 PM, so you can watch medal-clinching bouts in an air-conditioned theater and still have the afternoon free.
BOX17.potentialContendersIntro: The headline bouts are the women's 57kg and 75kg quarterfinals and the men's 55kg semifinals. Who actually qualifies won't be settled until May 2028, so these are projections based on recent form.

potentialContenders.name: Jaismine Lamboria
potentialContenders.note: The 2025 women's 57kg world champion after a 4-1 win over Szeremeta in the final. She took silver at the 2026 Asian Championships, so she looks beatable but dangerous.

potentialContenders.name: Julia Szeremeta
potentialContenders.note: Won 57kg silver at Paris 2024, losing the final to Lin Yu-ting, and was runner-up at the 2025 worlds. A likely contender if she qualifies.

potentialContenders.name: Lovlina Borgohain
potentialContenders.note: Won 2026 Asian Games 75kg gold with a 5-0 win over China's Bao Ziyi. A projected medal threat at 75kg.

potentialContenders.name: Aoife O'Rourke
potentialContenders.note: Beat China's Wang Lina by unanimous decision in the 2025 world semifinal at 75kg. A likely contender to reach the quarterfinals.

potentialContenders.name: Rui Yamaguchi
potentialContenders.note: Won men's 55kg gold at the 2026 Asian Games, beating the Philippines' Carlo Paalam in the final. A projected semifinalist if he makes Japan's team.

BOX18.blurb:
Every boxer in a semifinal ring is already guaranteed a medal. The only question is the color, and a win locks in at least silver. That is why these rounds tend to fight like finals. Wu Yu, the Paris 2024 flyweight champion, could be back at 51kg, and India's Parveen Hooda arrives at 65kg fresh off Asian Games gold.

The one gold on offer at midday is the women's 70kg title. DTLA Arena's steep bowl puts even the upper rows almost directly over the ring, so you can follow the footwork, the feints, and the corner talk between rounds.
BOX18.potentialContendersIntro: The marquee semifinals are women's 51kg, women's 65kg and men's 90kg. Qualification is still open, so every name below is a projection.

potentialContenders.name: Wu Yu
potentialContenders.note: Paris 2024 flyweight champion and 2026 Asian Games 51kg gold medalist (5-0 over Vietnam's Nguyen Thi Tam). A likely contender if she makes the team.

potentialContenders.name: Parveen Hooda
potentialContenders.note: Won 2026 Asian Games 65kg gold on a 3-2 split decision over Chen Nien-chin of Chinese Taipei. Projected to be in the mix at 65kg.

potentialContenders.name: Turabek Khabibullaev
potentialContenders.note: 2025 world champion at 90kg and 2026 Asian Games gold medalist. The projected man to beat in the 90kg semifinals.

potentialContenders.name: Lazizbek Mullojonov
potentialContenders.note: Paris 2024 heavyweight champion at 92kg, close to the 2028 limit. He could move to 90kg, but that is speculation.

BOX19.blurb:
Makhmud Sabyrkhan is the reigning world champion at 55kg, but the 2026 Asian Games showed the title is not a force field. He left with bronze while Japan's Rui Yamaguchi took gold. Put those two in a final here and the first gold of the evening could swing either way.

The 6 PM start gives the building a night-out feel, with the semifinal block building toward the men's 70kg and 80kg bouts. Kazakhstan's Torekhan Sabyrkhan and Jordan's Zeyad Eashash, who finished first and second at the 2026 Asian Games, are the kind of pairing that can turn a semifinal into a statement.
BOX19.potentialContendersIntro: The headline is the men's 55kg final, with men's 70kg semifinals as the next draw. These are projections for 2028, not confirmed entries.

potentialContenders.name: Makhmud Sabyrkhan
potentialContenders.note: 2025 world champion at 55kg, beating Spain's Rafael Lozano in the final. Bronze at the 2026 Asian Games makes him a favorite who is not unbeatable.

potentialContenders.name: Rui Yamaguchi
potentialContenders.note: Won 55kg gold at the 2026 Asian Games. A credible threat to the world champion if he qualifies.

potentialContenders.name: Torekhan Sabyrkhan
potentialContenders.note: Won 2026 Asian Games 70kg gold, 5-0 over Jordan's Zeyad Eashash. Likely to be a semifinal factor at 70kg.

potentialContenders.name: Zeyad Eashash
potentialContenders.note: 2025 world bronze medalist and 2026 Asian Championships gold medalist at 70kg, ranked number two by World Boxing before the Asian Games.

potentialContenders.name: Natnicha Chongprongklang
potentialContenders.note: Won 2026 Asian Games women's 54kg gold over DPR Korea's Pang Chol Mi, 4-1. Could reach the 54kg semifinals.

BOX20.blurb:
Aibek Oralbay has beaten Jakhongir Zokirov twice in major finals, 3-2 at the 2025 world championships and 5-0 at the 2026 Asian Games. A third meeting in the +90kg final would carry real tension. Heavyweights change the room: every exchange lands with a thud, and the crowd reacts to each one.

The question hanging over the division is Bakhodir Jalolov, the two-time Games champion, who lost out at the Asian Games and has been boxing professionally. His 2028 plans are unconfirmed.

Before that, the 60kg semifinals bring Lin Yu-ting, cleared by World Boxing in March 2026 after a sex test, and Uzbekistan's Abdumalik Khalokov.
BOX20.potentialContendersIntro: The main event is the men's +90kg final, with the women's and men's 60kg semifinals alongside it. All 2028 participation is projected.

potentialContenders.name: Aibek Oralbay
potentialContenders.note: 2025 world champion at +90kg and 2026 Asian Games gold medalist, beating Zokirov both times. Projected favorite.

potentialContenders.name: Jakhongir Zokirov
potentialContenders.note: Lost narrowly to Oralbay (3-2) in the 2025 world final, then 5-0 at the Asian Games. A possible final rematch.

potentialContenders.name: Bakhodir Jalolov
potentialContenders.note: Two-time defending super-heavyweight champion. Beat Solomon Dacres as a pro in October 2026, and his 2028 plans are not confirmed.

potentialContenders.name: Lin Yu-ting
potentialContenders.note: Paris 2024 champion at 57kg, now at 60kg. Won 2026 Asian Games gold, 5-0 over China's Yang Chengyu. A likely contender if she qualifies.

potentialContenders.name: Abdumalik Khalokov
potentialContenders.note: Paris 2024 featherweight champion, ranked top of World Boxing's men's 60kg list in March 2026 and 2026 Asian Games gold medalist.

BOX21.blurb:
One kilogram. That is the adjustment Wu Yu faces moving from Paris 2024 flyweight gold at 50kg to the 51kg class, and she looked unbothered at the 2026 Asian Games, winning 5-0. A Friday evening final for the lightest women's weight could be the cleanest technical showcase of the week.

The semifinals offer plenty of intrigue. In the men's 65kg bracket, Asadkhuja Muydinkhujaev, the Paris 2024 welterweight champion who topped the rankings, and Cuba's Erislandy Alvarez, the Paris 2024 lightweight champion who was ranked second, are on a possible collision course. In the 75kg semis, India's Lovlina Borgohain and China's Li Qian are the names to watch.
BOX21.potentialContendersIntro: The main draw is the women's 51kg final, with women's 75kg and men's 65kg semifinals. These are projections, not confirmed entries.

potentialContenders.name: Wu Yu
potentialContenders.note: Paris 2024 flyweight champion and 2026 Asian Games 51kg gold medalist. A projected favorite if she qualifies.

potentialContenders.name: Asadkhuja Muydinkhujaev
potentialContenders.note: Paris 2024 welterweight champion, then 2025 world champion at 65kg and ranked number one by World Boxing in June 2026.

potentialContenders.name: Erislandy Alvarez
potentialContenders.note: Paris 2024 lightweight champion and 2025 world bronze medalist at 65kg. A likely semifinal threat if he qualifies.

potentialContenders.name: Lovlina Borgohain
potentialContenders.note: Won 2026 Asian Games 75kg gold, 5-0 over China's Bao Ziyi. Projected to be in the 75kg mix.

potentialContenders.name: Li Qian
potentialContenders.note: Paris 2024 women's 75kg champion in a class that is now the heaviest women's division. Could return to defend her status.

BOX22.blurb:
Turabek Khabibullaev has won every big title he has entered lately, taking the 2025 world championship and the 2026 Asian Games at 90kg. He is a clear favorite for a Saturday-noon final, and nobody will be surprised if Brazil's Isaias Ribeiro, the 2025 world silver medalist, pushes him hard.

In the women's 65kg final, India's Parveen Hooda won her Asian Games gold on a 3-2 split, which is the kind of margin that keeps a finalist honest. The 57kg semifinals feel unusually open too. Lin Yu-ting, the Paris 2024 champion at that weight, has moved up to 60kg, leaving the division without a defending champion.
BOX22.potentialContendersIntro: The men's 90kg and women's 65kg finals headline this session. The 2028 fields are projections, and one name carries serious doubt.

potentialContenders.name: Turabek Khabibullaev
potentialContenders.note: 2025 world champion and 2026 Asian Games gold medalist at 90kg, 5-0 over China's Han Xuezhen. Projected favorite.

potentialContenders.name: Isaias Ribeiro
potentialContenders.note: 2025 world silver medalist at 90kg, a possible finalist if he qualifies.

potentialContenders.name: Parveen Hooda
potentialContenders.note: 2026 Asian Games 65kg champion (3-2 over Chen Nien-chin). A likely contender at 65kg.

potentialContenders.name: Imane Khelif
potentialContenders.note: Paris 2024 welterweight champion at 66kg, but a 2028 appearance looks unlikely: she has not competed in World Boxing events since its sex-testing policy began and is scheduled to make her pro debut on 15 December 2026.

BOX23.blurb:
Four gold medals in two hours is a lot of boxing, and the women's 60kg final might be the best of them. Lin Yu-ting won 2026 Asian Games gold, but Kazakhstan's Viktoriya Grafeyeva beat her in the 2026 World Boxing Cup final in China. Add Ireland's Kellie Harrington, the Paris 2024 champion in that division, who came out of retirement in October 2025, and the field gets compelling.

The evening also crowns the men's 60kg and 80kg titles, where Uzbekistan's Abdumalik Khalokov and Javokhir Ummataliev are the names to know. Saturday night in downtown LA will feel like a full card, one gold after another.
BOX23.potentialContendersIntro: The focus is the women's 60kg and men's 60kg finals. All 2028 entries are projections, including Harrington, who has not committed to the Games.

potentialContenders.name: Lin Yu-ting
potentialContenders.note: 2026 Asian Games 60kg gold medalist after moving up from 57kg, and World Boxing Cup silver medalist. Projected to be in the 60kg final if she qualifies.

potentialContenders.name: Viktoriya Grafeyeva
potentialContenders.note: 2025 world bronze medalist who beat Lin in the 2026 World Boxing Cup 60kg final. A real threat to the Taipei fighter.

potentialContenders.name: Kellie Harrington
potentialContenders.note: Two-time Games champion at 60kg, back from retirement since October 2025. She has said she is not yet focused on 2028, so her place is uncertain.

potentialContenders.name: Abdumalik Khalokov
potentialContenders.note: Paris 2024 featherweight champion, 2026 Asian Games gold medalist and top of World Boxing's men's 60kg rankings in March 2026. A likely favorite.

potentialContenders.name: Javokhir Ummataliev
potentialContenders.note: 2025 world champion at 80kg, beating France's Yojerlin Cesar in the final. Projected as a contender for the 80kg title.

BOX24.blurb:
The last four boxing gold medals of the Games go on a Sunday afternoon. The men's 65kg final could be the headliner: Asadkhuja Muydinkhujaev, the Paris 2024 welterweight champion, won the 2025 world title and was ranked number one, while Cuba's Erislandy Alvarez, the Paris 2024 lightweight champion, hunts for another gold.

The women's 57kg division is wide open, since Lin Yu-ting has moved to 60kg. Add Torekhan Sabyrkhan's 70kg run and India's Lovlina Borgohain at 75kg, and this closing session offers plenty of fresh faces on the final podium.
BOX24.potentialContendersIntro: The leading storylines are the men's 65kg and 70kg finals, plus women's 75kg. These are projections, since qualification closes on 31 May 2028.

potentialContenders.name: Asadkhuja Muydinkhujaev
potentialContenders.note: Paris 2024 welterweight champion, 2025 world champion at 65kg and ranked number one in June 2026. A projected favorite.

potentialContenders.name: Yuri Falcao
potentialContenders.note: 2025 world silver medalist at 65kg. A possible finalist if he qualifies.

potentialContenders.name: Torekhan Sabyrkhan
potentialContenders.note: Won 2026 Asian Games 70kg gold, 5-0 over Jordan's Zeyad Eashash. A likely contender at 70kg.

potentialContenders.name: Zeyad Eashash
potentialContenders.note: 2025 world bronze medalist and 2026 Asian Championships gold medalist at 70kg. Could challenge Sabyrkhan for the title.

potentialContenders.name: Lovlina Borgohain
potentialContenders.note: Won 2026 Asian Games 75kg gold over China's Bao Ziyi, with China's Li Qian, the Paris 2024 champion, as a possible rival. A projected contender.

BSB01.blurb:
Baseball gets the first word. Before the Opening Ceremony, before the crowds spread across the city, the 2028 Games begin in Chavez Ravine with a late-morning first pitch.

Dodger Stadium has done this before. In 1984, when baseball was a demonstration sport, games here averaged about 48,000 fans. The 1962 ballpark still has its pastel decks, with the downtown skyline and the hills beyond the outfield.

Come for the bragging rights of seeing the tournament's first inning, and for a look at rosters before the stakes pile up.
BSB01.potentialContendersIntro: Three of the six teams are confirmed: the United States as host, plus the Dominican Republic and Venezuela. Which of them opens the tournament depends on the schedule, so these are teams that could appear.

potentialContenders.name: USA
potentialContenders.note: Qualified as host and won silver at Tokyo 2020. Lost the last two World Baseball Classic finals, so there is unfinished business.

potentialContenders.name: Dominican Republic
potentialContenders.note: Tokyo 2020 bronze medalist, qualified through the 2026 World Baseball Classic.

potentialContenders.name: Venezuela
potentialContenders.note: Reigning World Baseball Classic champion, making its first Games baseball appearance.

BSB02.blurb:
Venezuela has never played a baseball game at the Games. On the night before the Opening Ceremony, under the lights at Dodger Stadium, the reigning World Baseball Classic champion could finally change that.

The last time Venezuela met the United States, Eugenio Suárez doubled in the ninth to beat a Bryce Harper-powered comeback in Miami, 3-2. Any rematch here would carry that sting.

The big question is who walks out in the uniforms. Whether active major leaguers play depends on unresolved talks, so the night is full of intrigue even before the first pitch.
BSB02.potentialContendersIntro: Venezuela and the United States are confirmed for the field, and a meeting between them would replay the 2026 Classic final. Which teams play this session is a scheduling matter, so treat these as teams that could take the field.

potentialContenders.name: Venezuela
potentialContenders.note: Won its first Classic title in March 2026 and is ranked 5th in the world. Making its Games debut.

potentialContenders.name: USA
potentialContenders.note: Host nation, beaten in the 2026 Classic final 3-2 and eager to answer on home turf.

potentialContenders.name: Dominican Republic
potentialContenders.note: Ranked 12th in the world at qualification. Beat Venezuela in 2026 Classic pool play.

BSB03.blurb:
The Opening Ceremony is behind us, the city is buzzing, and baseball is the first sport back at it on Saturday morning. The pitch may be thrown into a sun-drenched Chavez Ravine.

The Dominican Republic could be here to settle a score. It took bronze at Tokyo 2020, then lost a 2026 Classic semifinal 2-1 to the USA on a disputed called third strike.

The field also has holes. Tokyo 2020 gold medalist Japan is not yet in, so this is a session for watching who made it.
BSB03.potentialContendersIntro: Only the United States, the Dominican Republic and Venezuela are confirmed. The Asian entrant, whether Japan, Chinese Taipei or Korea, is still to be decided at the 2027 Premier12, so all projections here are speculative.

potentialContenders.name: Dominican Republic
potentialContenders.note: Tokyo 2020 bronze medalist, which beat South Korea 10-6 for the medal.

potentialContenders.name: Chinese Taipei
potentialContenders.note: Won the 2024 Premier12 and was No. 2 in the world at the end of 2025. Could appear if it wins the Asian spot.

potentialContenders.name: Japan
potentialContenders.note: Tokyo 2020 gold medalist. Must win the Asian spot at the 2027 Premier12 to reach Los Angeles.

potentialContenders.name: USA
potentialContenders.note: Host nation, and beat the Dominican Republic 2-1 in the 2026 Classic semifinal.

BSB04.blurb:
Saturday night at Dodger Stadium could belong to the underdogs. A European or Oceanian team is guaranteed a place in the field, and that has a good chance of being the team that surprises you.

Italy is a good example. It went to the 2026 Classic semifinals, beating Puerto Rico along the way. Players like Matteo Bocchi have said a Games berth is the long-term goal.

Get there as the sun sets over the hills. The tournament's edges are often where the best stories hide.
BSB04.potentialContendersIntro: The Europe/Oceania spot goes to the best of that region's teams at the 2027 Premier12, so every name below is a projection for a team that could qualify.

potentialContenders.name: Italy
potentialContenders.note: Reached the 2026 Classic semifinals, then clinched a 2027 Premier12 spot. Likely contender for the Europe/Oceania place.

potentialContenders.name: Netherlands
potentialContenders.note: A regular at top-level international events and in the Premier12 field on world ranking.

potentialContenders.name: Australia
potentialContenders.note: Oceania's strongest hope, set to play in the 2027 Premier12.

potentialContenders.name: Spain
potentialContenders.note: Qualified for its first Premier12 in October 2026. A long shot with a great story.

BSB05.blurb:
By Sunday morning the group stage is down to its last day, and the seeding for the knockouts is still being sorted out. Every inning counts.

Venezuela will be the team to watch. It won the 2026 Classic on strong pitching and clutch hits from Wilyer Abreu and Eugenio Suárez, with Maikel Garcia named MVP. Veteran catcher Salvador Perez was part of that team.

The real question hanging over the day is whether the same MLB stars will play in 2028. It's a lazy Sunday ballpark day with high stakes.
BSB05.potentialContendersIntro: The three confirmed teams are the likeliest to be in the mix for top seeds. Which sides play this session is not yet known, so these are teams that could appear.

potentialContenders.name: Venezuela
potentialContenders.note: 2026 Classic champion, whose best finish before that was the 2009 semifinals. A top seed is in reach.

potentialContenders.name: USA
potentialContenders.note: Host nation and Tokyo 2020 silver medalist. Aiming for a home-field seed.

potentialContenders.name: Dominican Republic
potentialContenders.note: Tokyo 2020 bronze medalist and a dangerous team if its major leaguers play.

BSB06.blurb:
This is the last night of the group stage, and the host nation could well be fighting for position. The pressure on the United States has never been higher.

Team USA lost two straight Classic finals, in 2023 and 2026, the latter to Venezuela 3-2 after Bryce Harper hit a game-tying homer. Mark DeRosa's squad was the tournament favorite in 2026.

Now the party is at Dodger Stadium, with the Dodgers' own home as a backdrop. Bring a jacket for the hilltop breeze and your voice.
BSB06.potentialContendersIntro: The United States is confirmed as host, and the other confirmed teams are the likeliest foils. These are the teams that could appear on the final night of the group stage.

potentialContenders.name: USA
potentialContenders.note: Host nation. Won silver at Tokyo 2020 and reached the 2026 Classic final under Mark DeRosa.

potentialContenders.name: Venezuela
potentialContenders.note: Beat the USA in the 2026 Classic final. A rematch would be a headline game.

potentialContenders.name: Dominican Republic
potentialContenders.note: Lost 2-1 to the USA in the 2026 Classic semifinal and would relish a rematch.

BSB07.blurb:
The knockout rounds begin on Monday, and now every game can end a team's tournament. The 11 a.m. start means a sun-drenched, tense midday in Chavez Ravine.

This is the first of two quarterfinals. The winner moves to the semifinals, and the loser goes home without a medal. Tokyo 2020 gold medalist Japan, Chinese Taipei and the Dominican Republic are all names that could be involved.

The tournament does not offer much room for error, so every pitching change and every ninth-inning at-bat is a drama.
BSB07.potentialContendersIntro: The final field is not set, so these are teams that could appear. Only the United States, Dominican Republic and Venezuela are confirmed.

potentialContenders.name: Dominican Republic
potentialContenders.note: Tokyo 2020 bronze medalist and a strong knockout-round presence.

potentialContenders.name: Japan
potentialContenders.note: Tokyo 2020 gold medalist, if it wins the Asian spot at the 2027 Premier12.

potentialContenders.name: Chinese Taipei
potentialContenders.note: Beat Japan 4-0 in the 2024 Premier12 final. Could appear if it qualifies.

potentialContenders.name: Italy
potentialContenders.note: 2026 Classic semifinalist, and a possible Europe/Oceania qualifier.

BSB08.blurb:
Monday night is quarterfinal, under the lights, with a Venezuela side that could be walking into Dodger Stadium as the champions of the world.

It beat Japan, Italy and the USA in the 2026 Classic knockouts, including a 3-2 final decided by Bryce Harper's 434-foot homer and an answer from Eugenio Suárez. Every opponent now sees them as the team to beat.

If active major leaguers play, this would be the first Games tournament in which they do. The hum of a big night at Chavez Ravine is a good reason to be there.
BSB08.potentialContendersIntro: Quarterfinal pairings depend on the group stage, so these are teams that could appear. Participation of MLB stars remains unsettled.

potentialContenders.name: Venezuela
potentialContenders.note: 2026 Classic champion, making its Games debut. Likely a title contender.

potentialContenders.name: USA
potentialContenders.note: Host nation, and the favorite on paper if MLB players take part.

potentialContenders.name: Dominican Republic
potentialContenders.note: Tokyo 2020 bronze medalist. Beat Venezuela in 2026 Classic pool play.

BSB09.blurb:
Two wins from a gold medal game. Tuesday's first semifinal is the last time any team can lose and still have a chance at bronze, so everything starts to feel permanent.

The obvious pairing would be a repeat of the 2026 Classic semifinal, which the USA won 2-1 over the Dominican Republic on Paul Skenes's start and a disputed called third strike. Venezuela, the Classic's champion, has not won a Games medal, because 2028 is its debut.

The Tuesday sun can make Dodger Stadium glow, and the stakes make it loud.
BSB09.potentialContendersIntro: The semifinal lineup is not known, so these are players who could feature if their countries advance and if major leaguers are allowed to play.

potentialContenders.name: Paul Skenes
potentialContenders.note: Started the USA's 2026 Classic semifinal win over the Dominican Republic. Could be a staff ace if he is available.

potentialContenders.name: Bryce Harper
potentialContenders.note: Has publicly pushed for MLB participation. Hit the game-tying homer in the 2026 Classic final.

potentialContenders.name: Ketel Marte
potentialContenders.note: Homered against Venezuela in 2026 Classic pool play. A likely Dominican threat if he plays.

potentialContenders.name: Maikel Garcia
potentialContenders.note: Named MVP of the 2026 Classic. Could anchor Venezuela's infield.

BSB10.blurb:
The second semifinal sends one team to the gold medal game and the other to a consolation fight. It's Tuesday night, and Dodger Stadium is full.

United States versus Venezuela is the matchup the tournament could be built for. Venezuela won the 2026 Classic final 3-2, handing the USA its second straight final defeat. Bryce Harper and Eugenio Suárez could hold the whole stadium's attention in a rematch.

First Games baseball with active major leaguers would be a milestone, and this is the kind of game that would show it.
BSB10.potentialContendersIntro: Nothing is settled about who plays, and MLB participation is unresolved, so these are players who could feature if their teams reach the semifinals.

potentialContenders.name: Bryce Harper
potentialContenders.note: Tied the 2026 Classic final with a 434-foot homer. A likely face of the US team if he plays.

potentialContenders.name: Eugenio Suárez
potentialContenders.note: Hit the ninth-inning go-ahead double in the 2026 Classic final.

potentialContenders.name: Wilyer Abreu
potentialContenders.note: Delivered a key hit in the 2026 final. Could be central to Venezuela's lineup.

potentialContenders.name: Gunnar Henderson
potentialContenders.note: Homered in the USA's 2-1 win over the Dominican Republic in the 2026 Classic semifinal.

BSB11.blurb:
Nobody wants to be here, and nobody wants to lose the game either. The bronze medal game pits the two semifinal losers against one another on a Wednesday late morning, and it can be a bruising, fierce thing.

The Dominican Republic knows. It won this game at Tokyo 2020, beating South Korea 10-6. Medals are medals, and the dugout energy tends to flip fast after a one-day sulk.

It is also the farewell for those who will not play on the final night, so watch it closely.
BSB11.potentialContendersIntro: The matchup is unknown until the semifinals are finished, so these players are speculative and would need to be on a roster that loses a semifinal.

potentialContenders.name: Ketel Marte
potentialContenders.note: Homered against Venezuela in the 2026 Classic. Could lead a Dominican push for a second straight bronze.

potentialContenders.name: Geraldo Perdomo
potentialContenders.note: Made the final out in the 2026 Classic semifinal on a disputed called third strike. A redemption storyline if he plays.

potentialContenders.name: Maikel Garcia
potentialContenders.note: 2026 Classic MVP. Would be a key figure if Venezuela lands here.

potentialContenders.name: Gunnar Henderson
potentialContenders.note: Homered in the 2026 Classic semifinal. Could appear if the host falls short.

BSB12.blurb:
Last time baseball was a Games sport, Japan beat the United States for the gold. This time, the gold medal game is at Dodger Stadium on a Wednesday night, with a crowd that can finally cheer a winner.

The story everyone wants is USA-Venezuela, a rematch of the 2026 Classic final that Venezuela won 3-2 in front of 36,190 in Miami. Bryce Harper tied it with an eighth-inning homer, and Eugenio Suárez broke his heart in the ninth.

The lights, the skyline and the last pitch of a tournament are why you buy this seat.
BSB12.potentialContendersIntro: The finalists depend on the semifinals, and MLB players' participation is unresolved, so these players are projections of who could be on the field.

potentialContenders.name: Bryce Harper
potentialContenders.note: Has publicly said he fought for the 2028 Games for a long time. A likely US star if MLB players take part.

potentialContenders.name: Paul Skenes

potentialContenders.name: Maikel Garcia

potentialContenders.name: Wilyer Abreu
potentialContenders.note: Delivered a key hit in the 2026 final. Could again be a Venezuelan lineup piece.

BSB13.blurb:
Nine in the morning, first pitch of the tournament, and the sun is already climbing over the Mecca of Softball. Everyone in the park knows this ground as the home of the Women's College World Series, and for one week it belongs to the world.

Six teams, five games each, no second chances. Every early result carries weight. The USA is the only confirmed team so far, and Japan and the USA are the projected powers.

Bring a hat. Little of the seating is shaded, and a midsummer Oklahoma morning still bites. The reward is a close view of the first pitch of a tournament that was missing from Paris 2024.
BSB13.potentialContendersIntro: Only the host USA is confirmed for 2028, so these are likely names based on the October 2026 world ranking.

potentialContenders.name: USA
potentialContenders.note: Confirmed as host and ranked No. 2 in the world in October 2026. A home-state opener is a built-in storyline.

potentialContenders.name: Japan
potentialContenders.note: Ranked No. 1 with 3,726 points and the Tokyo 2020 gold medalist. Projected to qualify, not yet confirmed.

potentialContenders.name: Canada
potentialContenders.note: Tokyo 2020 bronze medalist, ranked fourth in October 2026. A possible qualifier.

potentialContenders.name: Puerto Rico
potentialContenders.note: Ranked No. 3 in October 2026 and already into the 2027 World Cup Finals. Could push for a berth.

BSB14.blurb:
Japan arrives as the world's No. 1 team and the Tokyo 2020 champion, and the pitching story starts with names the crowd may already know. Yukiko Ueno, Miu Goto and Minori Naito, all gold medalists from Tokyo, were on Japan's November 2026 All-Star Series roster.

This is the first late-afternoon slot of the tournament, when the heat is still heavy but the shadows begin to stretch across the infield. Japan's brand of softball is patient, precise and merciless with small mistakes. It plays well in a ballpark built for the game.

If Japan qualifies, it will be the team everyone else is measured against.
BSB14.potentialContendersIntro: No 2028 berths beyond the host are set yet, so these are likely contenders based on current form.

potentialContenders.name: Japan
potentialContenders.note: Likely contender. World No. 1 and winner of Group Lima unbeaten in July 2026, with head coach Reika Utsugi building toward 2028.

potentialContenders.name: USA
potentialContenders.note: Confirmed host and the No. 2 team in the world, 240 ranking points behind Japan in October 2026.

potentialContenders.name: Australia
potentialContenders.note: World Cup Finals host in 2027. Coach Kerrie Porter says the team can challenge the best, though 2028 qualification is not yet settled.

BSB15.blurb:
Eight-thirty at night, lights on, and the home team's first showcase. The USA has not won Games softball gold since 2004. It finished second to Japan in 2008 and again at Tokyo 2020, and a crowd packed with Oklahoma softball diehards will want to see that change.

Patty Gasso runs the national team, and this park is as close to her home ground as the sport gets. Expect the noise to build the way it does at the Women's College World Series: gradually, then all at once.

Bring a jacket for the late innings. The game may still be going when the night cools.
BSB15.potentialContendersIntro: Rosters for 2028 are far from set, but these players were on the USA's November 2026 All-Star Series roster and could be part of the picture.

potentialContenders.name: Karlyn Pickens
potentialContenders.note: Pitcher on the USA's All-Star Series roster and a World Cup Group Oklahoma City qualifier. A possible 2028 arm if she stays in the pool.

potentialContenders.name: Maya Brady
potentialContenders.note: Part of the unbeaten World Cup Group Oklahoma City team in September 2026. Could be a lineup fixture.

potentialContenders.name: Jayda Coleman
potentialContenders.note: Another World Cup Group Oklahoma City veteran from the All-Star roster. A potential home-crowd favorite.

potentialContenders.name: Kayla Kowalik
potentialContenders.note: On the November 2026 All-Star Series roster. Worth watching if she keeps her place on the national team.

BSB16.blurb:
Canada has a habit of making the favorites nervous. The Tokyo 2020 bronze medalists got to the 2027 World Cup Finals with an 8-7, nine-inning win over Chinese Taipei, the kind of game that tells you about their temperament.

Monday morning at nine is a good time to see a team like that. The crowd is fresh, the sun is still low, and a team with something to prove can set the tone for the week.

Find a seat down the baselines. The park is built so even the upper rows feel close, and early games let you watch the whole field without the pressure of a deciding game.
BSB16.potentialContendersIntro: Only the USA is confirmed for 2028. These teams are likely contenders based on current form.

potentialContenders.name: Canada
potentialContenders.note: Tokyo 2020 bronze medalist and No. 4 in the October 2026 ranking. Already into the 2027 World Cup Finals, so a likely contender for a berth.

potentialContenders.name: Puerto Rico
potentialContenders.note: Ranked No. 3 in the world in October 2026. Could be a dangerous team in the Americas.

potentialContenders.name: Mexico
potentialContenders.note: Moved up to sixth in a 2026 ranking update. A rising team that could appear if it qualifies.

BSB17.blurb:
Australia's coach says her team believes it can challenge the best, and the 2027 World Cup Finals in Redcliffe are a chance to prove it. That belief is the story here. The Aussies are not the favorites, but this is a sport where one pitcher on a hot day can flip a game.

A late-afternoon start in Oklahoma means long shadows and a sun that still has some bite. The game moves quickly, the pitching is the main event, and the crowd gets to see a team that plays with nothing to lose.

The Asia/Oceania berth is decided in Shaoxing, China, in September 2027, so it will be interesting to see who earns the trip.
BSB17.potentialContendersIntro: Nobody except the USA is confirmed for 2028. The Asia/Oceania qualifier has one berth, so these teams are speculative.

potentialContenders.name: Australia
potentialContenders.note: Hosts the 2027 World Cup Finals. Coach Kerrie Porter says the team can challenge the best. A possible Asia/Oceania contender.

potentialContenders.name: China
potentialContenders.note: In the 2027 World Cup Finals field and host of the Asia/Oceania qualifier in Shaoxing. A possible contender for the berth.

potentialContenders.name: Chinese Taipei
potentialContenders.note: Also in the 2027 World Cup Finals field. Could be in the race for the Asia/Oceania berth.

BSB18.blurb:
Yukiko Ueno would turn 46 the day before this tournament begins. She won gold in 2008 and at Tokyo 2020, plus bronze in 2004, and Japan listed her as both pitcher and assistant coach for its November 2026 series against the USA.

She has not said she will play in 2028, so this is a maybe. But if she is on the roster, a late-night start in Oklahoma gives fans a chance to see a pitcher who has been dealing at the top level since before some of her opponents were born.

The lights, the noise and a legend in the circle make for a good night.
BSB18.potentialContendersIntro: Japan is projected to qualify but is not confirmed. These Tokyo 2020 gold medalists were on the November 2026 All-Star Series roster; 2028 selection is speculative.

potentialContenders.name: Yukiko Ueno
potentialContenders.note: Gold in 2008 and at Tokyo 2020, bronze in 2004. She has not confirmed she will play in 2028, when she would be 46.

potentialContenders.name: Miu Goto
potentialContenders.note: Tokyo 2020 gold medalist pitcher on the All-Star Series roster. Could anchor the staff if Japan qualifies.

potentialContenders.name: Minori Naito
potentialContenders.note: Tokyo 2020 gold medalist infielder who was on the All-Star Series roster. A possible lineup piece.

BSB19.blurb:
By Tuesday morning, the tournament has found its shape. Teams have played a game or two, the standings have a first rough outline, and nobody can afford a sleepy start.

This is the slot where the middle of the field shows what it has. Puerto Rico was third in the world in October 2026, Canada fourth, and Mexico has been climbing. Any of them can make life hard for a favorite.

Watch the shadows on the infield as the sun climbs. The heat builds fast, and the teams that handle the long game, the quick adjustments and the small mistakes are the ones that end up in contention.
BSB19.potentialContendersIntro: Only the USA is confirmed for 2028. These teams are likely contenders if they qualify, based on the October 2026 ranking.

potentialContenders.name: Puerto Rico
potentialContenders.note: Ranked No. 3 with 3,002 points in October 2026. Already into the 2027 World Cup Finals.

potentialContenders.name: Canada
potentialContenders.note: Tokyo 2020 bronze medalist ranked fourth. Could be a dark horse against anyone in the field.

potentialContenders.name: Mexico
potentialContenders.note: Climbed to sixth in a 2026 ranking update. A possible qualifier and a team to watch.

potentialContenders.name: Japan
potentialContenders.note: World No. 1 and unbeaten in Group Lima in July 2026. Likely contender, not yet confirmed.

BSB20.blurb:
Oklahoma City is the only host city outside California, and the way fans get here is a bit different too. Tickets come through a registration-based draw with random purchase windows, so anyone in the park this Tuesday evening got lucky.

They are also in the right place. This is the home of the Women's College World Series, and the USA's 36-player athlete pool is built to deliver a team to a crowd that knows the game cold.

Late afternoon is a good time to be here. The light is golden, the heat starts to ease, and you can see why organizers chose a softball-only ballpark over a temporary build in Los Angeles.
BSB20.potentialContendersIntro: The USA is the only confirmed team for 2028. These are likely contenders based on form and ranking.

potentialContenders.name: USA
potentialContenders.note: Confirmed host, unbeaten at World Cup Group Oklahoma City in September 2026. The 2028 roster will come from a 36-player pool.

potentialContenders.name: Canada
potentialContenders.note: Tokyo 2020 bronze medalist and a likely qualifier. Could be a tricky opponent for the host.

potentialContenders.name: Puerto Rico
potentialContenders.note: No. 3 in the October 2026 ranking. A likely contender for the Americas berth.

BSB21.blurb:
Somewhere in the stands tonight there will be fans who watched this team qualify the hard way. The Americas berth is up for grabs in 2027, and the path through the continental qualifier is one of the toughest roads in this sport.

Puerto Rico, ranked third in the world in October 2026, is the obvious contender. Mexico, which climbed to sixth in a 2026 update, is a rising challenger.

This is the late-night slot, 8:30 under the lights, when the park gets louder and the game feels bigger. A team that earned its spot gets to show the host's home crowd why it deserved it.
BSB21.potentialContendersIntro: Only the USA is confirmed. The Americas berth, the Final Qualification Event and other paths are still open, so these are speculative.

potentialContenders.name: Puerto Rico
potentialContenders.note: No. 3 in the world in October 2026 and in the 2027 World Cup Finals. A possible contender for the Americas berth.

potentialContenders.name: Mexico
potentialContenders.note: Rose to sixth in a 2026 ranking update. Could emerge from the Americas qualifier if it plays well.

potentialContenders.name: USA
potentialContenders.note: Confirmed host. Whoever it faces here will be playing in front of a heavy home crowd.

BSB22.blurb:
Japan 2, USA 0 in Tokyo. The USA then beat Japan on its way to gold at The World Games 2025 in Chengdu. The scoreboard is level on paper, and this session could be the next chapter.

The world ranking tells the same story: Japan No. 1, the USA No. 2, 240 points apart in October 2026. Two teams have spent years trying to solve each other, and now they could meet at the sport's spiritual home, in front of a crowd that may lean heavily one way.

Midweek morning, nine o'clock, and the heat is still manageable. The pressure is already full.
BSB22.potentialContendersIntro: A Japan-USA matchup is a projection, not a schedule fact, and 2028 rosters are open. These players were on recent All-Star Series rosters.

potentialContenders.name: Miu Goto
potentialContenders.note: Tokyo 2020 gold medalist pitcher on Japan's All-Star Series roster. Could be a key arm if Japan qualifies.

potentialContenders.name: Yukiko Ueno
potentialContenders.note: Gold in 2008 and at Tokyo 2020. She has not confirmed 2028 plans and would be 46.

potentialContenders.name: Karlyn Pickens
potentialContenders.note: Pitcher on the USA's All-Star roster and World Cup Group Oklahoma City team. A possible 2028 starter.

potentialContenders.name: Maya Brady
potentialContenders.note: Part of the unbeaten September 2026 World Cup qualifier team. Could be a lineup anchor.

BSB23.blurb:
Wednesday afternoon is the middle of the tournament, and it is where the standings begin to bite. A loss now still leaves a path, but a second one usually does not.

That makes this a good session for fans who want to see how teams respond to their first real pressure. A Japan or USA game here would be the clearest read on whether the pre-tournament hype was justified.

The field is not set yet. The Asia/Oceania qualifier and a Final Qualification Event by March 2028 will fill the last spots, so part of the fun is guessing who ends up on the field.
BSB23.potentialContendersIntro: Only the USA is confirmed, and everything else is projected. These teams are likely contenders based on current form.

potentialContenders.name: Japan
potentialContenders.note: World No. 1 with 3,726 points and Tokyo 2020 gold medalist. A likely contender if it qualifies.

potentialContenders.name: USA
potentialContenders.note: Confirmed host and No. 2 in the October 2026 ranking.

potentialContenders.name: Canada
potentialContenders.note: Tokyo 2020 bronze medalist and a possible dark horse, if it qualifies.

BSB24.blurb:
Late Wednesday night is for the teams that do not have much margin left. Three games in, the arithmetic starts to matter, and the gap between third and fourth is the difference between a bronze game and going home.

Puerto Rico, Canada and Mexico are the kind of teams that can turn a quiet evening into a nervy one. They are talented, they are not intimidated by anyone, and they know a single upset reshapes the table.

The lights are on, the temperature is easier, and the crowd has had days to find its voice. This is when the park sounds like itself.
BSB24.potentialContendersIntro: Who reaches 2028 beyond the USA is still open. These teams are likely contenders if they qualify.

potentialContenders.name: Puerto Rico
potentialContenders.note: Ranked No. 3 in the October 2026 ranking with 3,002 points. A likely contender.

potentialContenders.name: Canada
potentialContenders.note: Fourth in the ranking with 2,728 points and Tokyo 2020 bronze medalist. Could be a medal contender again.

potentialContenders.name: Japan
potentialContenders.note: World No. 1 and a projected favorite, not yet qualified.

BSB25.blurb:
Thursday morning is the penultimate day, and that tends to bring a particular tension. The top two teams go to the gold medal game, and everyone else is racing the clock.

If Yukiko Ueno makes Japan's roster at 46, this is the kind of game where experience pays off. She has not confirmed her plans, so that is a maybe, but the idea of a pitcher with gold from 2008 and Tokyo 2020 still in the circle is hard to forget.

The sun is high, the shade is scarce, and the games are tight. Nobody has room left to be casual.
BSB25.potentialContendersIntro: Only the USA is confirmed for 2028. These teams are speculative, based on Tokyo 2020 medals and current form.

potentialContenders.name: Japan
potentialContenders.note: Tokyo 2020 gold medalist and No. 1 in the world. Ueno's 2028 plans are unconfirmed.

potentialContenders.name: Canada
potentialContenders.note: Tokyo 2020 bronze medalist. Could be in the hunt for a medal if it qualifies.

potentialContenders.name: Chinese Taipei
potentialContenders.note: In the 2027 World Cup Finals field. Lost a nine-inning game to Canada in Prague, so they know how close it can get.

BSB26.blurb:
Two teams went unbeaten on their way to the 2027 World Cup Finals: Japan in Lima, the USA in Oklahoma City. By this late-afternoon slot on Thursday, one of them may be the only team still playing without worry.

That is the tension. A team that has won everything can lose its nerve when the table gets tight, and teams like Puerto Rico and Mexico know exactly how to exploit that.

The heat is still heavy at four o'clock. You will want water, a hat and a good seat, because the next session or two is where the medal games get decided.
BSB26.potentialContendersIntro: 2028 fields are not set beyond the host USA. These are likely contenders, based on the October 2026 ranking.

potentialContenders.name: Japan

potentialContenders.name: USA

potentialContenders.name: Puerto Rico
potentialContenders.note: No. 3 in the ranking. Could play a spoiler role late in the round robin.

BSB27.blurb:
This is the last night of the round robin. After the final out, the top two teams book the gold medal game, the next two go for bronze, and two others go home. Gold is set for July 29, just a day before the Closing Ceremony.

It is a late start, 8:30 under the lights, and any scenario is possible. The standings may be tied, tiebreakers may matter, and fans may be doing math on their phones between pitches.

That is the beauty of a short tournament. Every pitch can swing a medal, and nobody in the park will be leaving early.
BSB27.potentialContendersIntro: Only the USA is confirmed for 2028, so these are likely contenders based on Tokyo 2020 results and the October 2026 ranking.

potentialContenders.name: Japan
potentialContenders.note: Tokyo 2020 gold medalist and No. 1 in the world. Likely contender if it qualifies.

potentialContenders.name: USA
potentialContenders.note: Confirmed host and the Tokyo 2020 silver medalist. Looking for its first Games gold since 2004.

potentialContenders.name: Canada
potentialContenders.note: Tokyo 2020 bronze medalist. Could be fighting for a medal spot if it qualifies.

potentialContenders.name: Puerto Rico
potentialContenders.note: Ranked No. 3 in October 2026. A possible bronze-game contender.

BSB28.blurb:
Nobody builds a softball career dreaming of a bronze game, and that is exactly why this one crackles. Two teams that just missed the gold medal game get one evening to send somebody home with a medal and somebody home with nothing.

Canada knows the feeling in the good direction: it won bronze at Tokyo 2020. Puerto Rico arrives ranked third in the world as of October 2026, and Mexico has been climbing the rankings. Any of them could be playing for this medal if the round-robin goes sideways for the favorites.

The seven o'clock start in Oklahoma City should take the edge off the midsummer heat at a ballpark where the stands sit close to the dirt. Expect the loud, flag-waving crowd of a college World Series night.
BSB28.potentialContendersIntro: Third and fourth place after the five-game round-robin meet here, so the field is projected, not set. Based on October 2026 rankings and recent qualifying results, these teams could land in this game, assuming they qualify.

potentialContenders.name: Canada
potentialContenders.note: Won bronze at Tokyo 2020 and qualified for the 2027 World Cup Finals with an 8-7, nine-inning win over Chinese Taipei. Ranked fourth as of October 2026, so a likely contender for a medal-round spot.

potentialContenders.name: Puerto Rico
potentialContenders.note: Ranked No. 3 in the world in October 2026 with 3,002 points and already qualified for the 2027 World Cup Finals. Could be the Americas qualifier to watch.

potentialContenders.name: Mexico
potentialContenders.note: Moved up to sixth in a 2026 WBSC ranking update and is in the 2027 World Cup Finals field. A rising team that could crash the medal games if it qualifies.

potentialContenders.name: Australia
potentialContenders.note: Hosts the 2027 World Cup Finals. Speculative: qualification for 2028 would come through the regional or Final Qualification Event routes.

BSB29.blurb:
Two-nil. That was the score when Japan beat the USA for gold at Tokyo 2020, and the Americans have been chasing the rematch ever since. They haven't won Games softball gold since 2004, finishing second to Japan in 2008 and again in Tokyo.

This time the final could be played on American soil, in the Oklahoma City park that hosts the Women's College World Series. Japan is ranked No. 1, but the USA beat Japan on the way to gold at The World Games 2025. The gap between them is thin.

Be in your seat for the nine o'clock first pitch, when the sun is still low and the heat has not peaked. Yukiko Ueno, still on Japan's November 2026 roster, is a reminder of how long this rivalry has run.
BSB29.potentialContendersIntro: Japan, ranked No. 1 in October 2026, and the USA, ranked No. 2, are the projected favorites for this game. Rosters for 2028 are not set, so these names are speculative.

potentialContenders.name: Yukiko Ueno
potentialContenders.note: Named to Japan's roster for the November 2026 All-Star Series against the USA as both a pitcher and an assistant coach. Whether she is on the 2028 roster is unknown, but she is a link between Japan's gold-medal eras.

potentialContenders.name: Jordy Bahl
potentialContenders.note: Speculative: a young pitcher with deep Oklahoma roots who could be a USA staff candidate and would be playing close to home if she makes the team.

potentialContenders.name: NiJaree Canady
potentialContenders.note: Speculative: a standout college pitcher and a possible USA staff candidate. If she makes the team, she could take the ball against Japan's lineup.

CER01A.blurb:
Two stadiums, one show, roughly ten miles apart. No modern Games has ever opened this way, and no seat in either building will give you the whole picture. That is the gamble, and the draw.

The ticket here is for the Inglewood bowl, the translucent-canopied stadium that will be called 2028 Stadium. Expect the open sides to let the coastal breeze in as the 5 PM start slides toward evening, with the ring-shaped video board overhead tying your half of the night to the Coliseum's. The Coliseum, which opened the 1932 and 1984 Games, will be the other half.

Kathleen Kennedy, the former Lucasfilm president, now leads the ceremonies team. Top seats have reportedly gone for more than $5,000, so go for the spectacle, not the bargain. Medals start right after, with the women's triathlon.
CER01A.potentialContendersIntro: There is no competition here, so no contenders in the usual sense.

CER02.blurb:
The Coliseum has done this twice before, and in 2028 it becomes the first stadium to host a ceremony at three Summer Games. You will be sitting in a 1923 landmark when the Games end.

The plan once called for splitting the farewell with the stadium in Inglewood. In November 2025 the Los Angeles City Council voted unanimously to keep it all at the Coliseum, so this is one bowl, one crowd and one last night. The open-air bowl holds the day's sun, then cools into a Southern California evening as the 6 PM start rolls on.

Expect athletes spilling onto the infield, an artistic send-off shaped by Kathleen Kennedy's team, and the flag handover to the next host. Paris sent Tom Cruise off a roof. Los Angeles now has to answer with its own farewell.
CER02.potentialContendersIntro: Ceremonies are non-competitive, so there are no contenders to list.

CKT01.blurb:
The last time cricket handed out medals at a Summer Games, in 1900, Great Britain beat France in a single match. The wait ends at nine on a Wednesday morning in Pomona.

This is the first cricket session of the 2028 Games, on a ground built inside Fairplex, where the Los Angeles County Fair has run since 1922. Seats sit close to the boundary and the inland sun is already climbing. The Knight Riders won their first Major League Cricket title in 2026, so the oval comes with a bit of local pedigree.

Whoever walks out first writes a line in the record book.
CKT01.potentialContendersIntro: Australia, India, Great Britain and South Africa have confirmed places. The match-ups for this session are unknown, so these are the teams most likely to feature.

potentialContenders.name: Australia
potentialContenders.note: Reigning T20 world champions, unbeaten at the 2026 World Cup. Could easily be in the first match of the Games.

potentialContenders.name: India
potentialContenders.note: Qualified as Asia's representative despite a group-stage exit at the 2026 World Cup. Could arrive with something to prove.

potentialContenders.name: Great Britain
potentialContenders.note: Qualified directly. England lost the 2026 World Cup final to Australia after reaching it unbeaten.

potentialContenders.name: South Africa
potentialContenders.note: Qualified directly after finishing runners-up at the 2023 and 2024 World Cups.

CKT02.blurb:
Opening day gets a second act. By six o'clock the Pomona heat has eased and the fairgrounds feel like a night out rather than a morning shift.

Evening T20 is a different animal. Chasing sides read the scoreboard like a clock, and a single big over can swing a game. The 2026 World Cup final showed it: Australia reeled in 150 for 4 with nearly three overs to spare to beat England by seven wickets.

Pick this session if you want the first day to end with a crowd that has found its voice, and a table that has started to take shape.
CKT02.potentialContendersIntro: Pairings for the evening game haven't been confirmed. These are the confirmed teams most likely to appear, with one speculative note on the hosts.

potentialContenders.name: Australia
potentialContenders.note: Won the 2026 World Cup unbeaten and chased down England at Lord's. A likely title favorite.

potentialContenders.name: Great Britain
potentialContenders.note: England made the 2026 final and could bring that core to Pomona.

potentialContenders.name: India
potentialContenders.note: Won the first women's T20 gold silver at the 2022 Commonwealth Games, a seven-run loss to Australia, and could be hungry for revenge.

potentialContenders.name: South Africa
potentialContenders.note: Two straight World Cup finals in 2023 and 2024 make them a dangerous early opponent.

CKT03.blurb:
Day two, and the pressure arrives early. In a short group stage, one slip on matchday two can stay with a team all the way to the table's final line.

India know the feeling. They went out of the 2026 World Cup in the group stage, yet they still hold Asia's place in Pomona and could be playing with a point to prove. A rest day follows on July 14, so nobody can hide behind the next fixture.

The nine o'clock start is a good value seat for a first look at the field before the calendar gets tight.
CKT03.potentialContendersIntro: The pairings for this morning session are not confirmed. Here are the confirmed qualifiers who could appear.

potentialContenders.name: India
potentialContenders.note: Secured Asia's place despite a 2026 World Cup group-stage exit. Could be keen to reset.

potentialContenders.name: South Africa
potentialContenders.note: Runners-up at the 2023 and 2024 World Cups. Could be a tricky early test for anyone.

potentialContenders.name: Australia
potentialContenders.note: Reigning world champions and the team others will measure themselves against.

potentialContenders.name: Great Britain
potentialContenders.note: England reached the 2026 final unbeaten and could be a contender for gold.

CKT04.blurb:
Last game before the break. Teams will want to head into July 14 with a win and a story to tell, and the evening start gives it the feel of a Thursday-night headliner.

Australia qualified as the top-ranked Oceania team, a quiet detail that hides how much they bring: a 2026 World Cup title won unbeaten and seven titles in ten tournaments. They are the side everyone else hopes to catch off guard.

If you want to see the tournament's early shape before the rest day lets everyone exhale, this is the session.
CKT04.potentialContendersIntro: Who plays tonight has not been set. These teams have confirmed places and could appear.

potentialContenders.name: Australia
potentialContenders.note: Qualified as the top-ranked Oceania team. Seven World Cup titles from ten tournaments.

potentialContenders.name: India
potentialContenders.note: Lost to Australia in the 2022 Commonwealth Games final by seven runs. Could be motivated by another meeting.

potentialContenders.name: Great Britain
potentialContenders.note: Qualified directly through the 2026 pathway. England's lone World Cup win came in 2009.

potentialContenders.name: South Africa
potentialContenders.note: Reached back-to-back World Cup finals and might be a dark horse for gold.

CKT05.blurb:
After a day off, the bats come back out on a Saturday morning, which suits a family outing better than most Games tickets.

South Africa are the story to follow. They were runners-up at both the 2023 and 2024 Women's T20 World Cups, close enough to feel the trophy but not close enough to hold it. A first Games medal would be a different kind of consolation.

Grab a seat near the boundary and you can hear the ball come off the bat before the fielders even move.
CKT05.potentialContendersIntro: This session's pairings haven't been published. These confirmed teams could take the field.

potentialContenders.name: South Africa
potentialContenders.note: Runners-up at the 2023 and 2024 World Cups. A medal here would finally turn near-misses into hardware.

potentialContenders.name: Australia
potentialContenders.note: Reigning T20 world champions and favorites to reach the gold medal match.

potentialContenders.name: India
potentialContenders.note: Asia's automatic qualifier, likely to be a dangerous side with a deep batting lineup.

potentialContenders.name: Great Britain
potentialContenders.note: England lost the 2026 final by seven wickets and could arrive hungry.

CKT06.blurb:
Two seats at the table were unsettled for a long time, and by now we should know who got them. That adds a kind of mystery to the evening, as the final first-round session brings the field fully into view.

New Zealand, the 2024 World Cup champions, did not qualify directly. They could be here if they came through the Women's Champions Trophy reallocation or the January-February 2028 qualifier. If they are, it is a story with real weight.

Catch the last of the first-round games with a Saturday night crowd.
CKT06.potentialContendersIntro: Which sides appear is not yet known. These are speculative names for the tournament's final first-round game.

potentialContenders.name: New Zealand
potentialContenders.note: 2024 World Cup winners not directly qualified. Could reach the Games via the Champions Trophy reallocation or qualifier.

CKT07.blurb:
The second round starts on a Sunday morning, and now every result carries weight. The top two teams play for gold, third and fourth for bronze, so every wicket becomes a table question.

That changes how you watch. A chase that is only a good story in round one becomes a tiebreaker with a medal attached. Captains start to bowl their best overs earlier, and batters stop saving their risks for later.

Pomona on a Sunday at nine has plenty of space and sunshine, which makes it one of the easier tickets to enjoy.

CKT08.blurb:
Sunday evening under softer light is when a T20 game feels best. The sun drops behind the grandstand, the shadows lengthen across the square, and the chase starts to feel like theater.

The table is tightening, and with medal matches only days away, the nerves should show. You may see a captain tweak a field with one over left, or a batter go for a boundary she would not have attempted a week earlier.

The second-round evening game is the kind of ticket you'd choose if you wanted atmosphere with real consequences.

One team is missing from the confirmed list, and Monday morning might be where you meet them. Pakistan's women missed direct qualification and had to go through the ICC qualifier, and the winner of that eight-team event takes the final women's place.

If Pakistan made it, expect a lot of noise from the stands. Whoever won that last seat will arrive with nothing to lose, and that makes a dangerous opponent for the established powers.

The medal matches are two days away, so this is a good session to see the table's fine print being written.

CKT10.blurb:
With the medal matches on July 19 and 20, Monday evening is when the arithmetic gets real. A team can be one bad over from a bronze match, or one good one from gold.

The evening session brings cooler air and a crowd that has watched a week of cricket and now knows the plot. That tends to sharpen the noise: sharper cheers for a boundary, an audible gasp for a dropped catch.

For someone wanting to see the pressure build before the finals, this is a solid ticket.

Beth Mooney was Player of the Match in the 2026 World Cup final and Player of the Series. If she is still opening for Australia in Pomona, Tuesday morning could be a masterclass in setting up a chase.

This is the final day of women's group play, and the scoreboard matters more than anywhere else. Seeds get settled, and teams on the edge are watching other results as closely as their own.

The nine o'clock start is the calm before a loud evening, and an easy way to see top-level cricket without needing to stay all day.

CKT12.blurb:
Last group game, last chance. Whatever happens tonight decides who plays for bronze and gold, and the crowd will know it as soon as the toss is done.

Nat Sciver-Brunt made an unbeaten 58 in the 2026 final and still lost. If she is leading Great Britain at the 2028 Games, this is the sort of evening where one calm innings can rewrite a group table.

Pomona's evening light, a full house, and a home ground the Knight Riders have already turned into a title winner. It is a good night to be there.

CKT13.blurb:
Bronze is where a tournament's heartbreak and relief meet. One team has just missed a gold medal match, the other is hoping to leave with something to hold.

This is the first cricket medal match at a Summer Games since 1900, when Great Britain played France in Paris. Morning light and a crowd with a lot to say make it a good fit for a game with nothing to lose.

In T20, a single over can end it. Sit near the boundary and you will hear every shot, every appeal, and every sigh.

A first gold medal in women's cricket at a Summer Games, and it will be decided on a Thursday morning in Pomona. Australia have won seven of the ten Women's T20 World Cups, so many people expect to see them here.

The 2026 final at Lord's was a seven-wicket win over England, with Beth Mooney's 64 off 49 balls leading the chase. If those two meet again, Nat Sciver-Brunt's unbeaten 58 gives England a score to settle.

The game starts at nine and could finish around lunchtime, with plenty of sun and a crowd that will remember where it was.

India's men won the 2026 T20 World Cup by 96 runs, a rout of New Zealand in Ahmedabad for a third title. Now they arrive in Pomona with the whole sport watching.

But the rankings say the gap is thin. In early November 2026, England led on 269, India sat at 267, and Australia were close on 260. Add a United States side, ranked 13th and reportedly assured a place as hosts, and the opening day has a bit of everything.

A Saturday-morning start at nine is a good way to see the men's tournament begin.

The men's opening day ends under a fading Pomona sky, and the stakes are plain. Only six teams are in the field, so there is nowhere to hide from the first ball. Cricket last had a men's match at a Summer Games in 1900, when Great Britain beat France in Paris.

The rankings say the gap at the top is thin. England led on 269 in November 2026, India sat on 267, and Australia trailed on 260.

The Fairgrounds ground seats about 10,000 close to the boundary, and it is home to the Los Angeles Knight Riders, who won their first Major League Cricket title in 2026. Sit near the rope and a six has a real chance of landing in your lap.

Cricket makes for a fine Sunday morning. First ball is at 9 a.m., the inland sun is already climbing, and the teams are still feeling each other out.

South Africa are worth watching early. Fifth in the rankings and the projected African entry, they lost the 2026 T20 World Cup semi-final to New Zealand by nine wickets. They will want a better ending on a bigger stage.

India are the other pull, as the first team to defend a T20 World Cup title after winning in 2024 and again in 2026. If either side is on the field, this early slot will not feel like an undercard.

England lost the 2026 T20 World Cup semi-final to India by seven runs. Here they play as Great Britain, and the rematch energy is hard to miss.

That loss came before a summer in which England took the world number one ranking from India with a 4-0 series win. Harry Brook and Jos Buttler put on 233 together in the fifth T20I at Southampton, Buttler with a century and Brook unbeaten on 95.

Sunday evening in Pomona should suit that kind of batting. A 6 p.m. start puts the day's heat behind you, and a ground built close to the boundary rewards anyone who clears the rope.

The qualifier is where New Zealand come in. They lost the 2026 T20 World Cup final to India by 96 runs, and as fourth in the rankings they trail Australia for Oceania's direct place.

A 9 a.m. Monday start will mean a smaller, more devoted crowd. These are the seats for seeing who made it.

A rating of 183 puts them well behind Australia, who sit on 260. The gap between the two is the reason a home upset would be loud.

The ground belongs to the Los Angeles Knight Riders, 2026 Major League Cricket champions with Sunil Narine as player of the series. This crowd already knows the sport, and a 6 p.m. start gives them a long evening.

Whether he is in India's 15 is a question for the next year and a half. The squad has already moved on, with Shreyas Iyer named captain.

Tuesday's 9 a.m. start offers a clear view of the group table taking shape. Matchups depend on who qualifies, and the seats are near the boundary, so sixes will come into the crowd.

Ireland would have to come through the January-February 2028 qualifier to reach this stage, but the result is a reminder that no team is safe in a six-team field.

The team that won the final in Ahmedabad by 96 runs, with 255/5, is a different proposition to the one that left Belfast empty-handed. Which version shows up in Pomona, with a gold medal at stake, is a story you can watch in person.

It is also the final chance to see the full field before the knockout stage. England's strong 2026 form against India and Sri Lanka, India's two world titles, and Australia's depth are all there to be tested.

The 9 a.m. start on Friday has a different feel from the gold-medal day that follows. It is closer to a relaxed exhibition, but with a medal on the line the bowlers will not take it easy.

CLB01.blurb:
Sorato Anraku wins men's Boulder so often that the interesting question is who can make him sweat. He is the reigning world champion, he took five World Climbing Series stops in 2026, and he arrives in Long Beach as the man to beat.

This is the semifinal, where no medals are handed out but one fall on a single problem can erase a season of favoritism. Boulder is short and violent: a few moves, one hold, a crowd that gasps in unison.

Get a seat early. The Pacific sits behind the wall, the morning light is low, and you will see the whole field before the cut.

CLB02.blurb:
4.54 seconds. That is the men's world record, set by China's Zhao Yicheng at 16, and it is the number everyone in this session is chasing or fearing.

Qualification is the part of Speed that casual fans skip and shouldn't. Climbers race for time, and those times set the knockout bracket, so a slip here can wreck a medal chance before a single head-to-head race begins.

On the women's side, American Emma Hunt has already gone under six seconds, a barrier Aleksandra Mirosław held off for years. Men and women run back to back, and the afternoon moves fast.

CLB03.blurb:
Janja Garnbret can be beaten, and in 2026 France's Zélia Avezou showed how by taking the Keqiao season opener. That is the thread into this semifinal: a climber with 10 world titles, and a field that no longer fears her.

The chasing pack is deep. Erin McNeice led the 2026 Boulder standings into the final stop, with Oceania Mackenzie and Annie Sanders behind her, and France's Oriane Bertone came within one unfinished boulder of the 2025 world title.

Women's Boulder has never had a medal of its own at the Games, so this Tuesday-morning semifinal is the first real cut toward one.
CLB03.potentialContendersIntro: Garnbret won Paris 2024 in the combined event and the 2025 world Boulder title. The names below are projections, since 2028 rosters are not set.

potentialContenders.name: Brooke Raboutou

CLB04.blurb:
Lead is one climb, one attempt, and the highest hold wins. That is why a Tuesday-evening semifinal can feel so tense: no second chances, just a climber, a rope, and a wall that ends in a clip or a fall.

South Korea's Lee Dohyun won the 2025 world title in front of a home crowd in Seoul, and Japan's Neo Suzuki took the 2026 series. Sorato Anraku, better known for Boulder, still finished second in the Lead standings.

Then there is Toby Roberts, the Paris champion who spent part of 2026 recovering from injury. It is a short session, with no time to look away.

CLB05.blurb:
Emma Hunt ran 5.99 in Kraków, the first women's time under six seconds, then slipped in the re-run and went home with bronze. That is Speed in one story: absurd brilliance and one wrong foot.

Put it in Long Beach with a home crowd and the stakes get larger. Sam Watson, a Paris bronze medalist who ran a 4.60 personal best to win in Kraków, could be racing Zhao Yicheng, the teenager who owns the 4.54 world record.

Quarterfinals, semifinals and both finals fit into ninety Wednesday-morning minutes, and each race is over in a few seconds. Do not blink.
CLB05.potentialContendersIntro: Both the men's and women's finals are decided here. Paris 2024 champions Veddriq Leonardo and Aleksandra Mirosław are confirmed history, but these 2028 names are projections.

potentialContenders.name: Desak Made Rita Kusuma Dewi
