MTB02.blurb:
Haley Batten knows what second place feels like. In Paris she took silver, 2:57 behind Pauline Ferrand-Prévot, and in 2028 she could get to chase gold in front of a home crowd.

The field she would face has turned over. Sina Frei is the 2026 world champion. Jenny Rissveds, the Rio 2016 champion, won the 2026 World Cup overall. Ferrand-Prévot's long-term focus appears to be the road.

With no heats, one mass start decides everything over roughly an hour and a half. At Industry Hills, the viewing areas let you follow the race lap by lap as riders pass several times across the hillside.
MTB02.potentialContendersIntro: Paris 2024 gold went to Ferrand-Prévot, silver to Batten and bronze to Rissveds. Who lines up in 2028 is not settled, so this list leans on 2026 form and is projection.

potentialContenders.name: Sina Frei
potentialContenders.note: Won her first elite world title in 2026, finishing 1:07 clear, and also won the Lake Placid World Cup finale in a sprint. A likely favorite if that form holds.

potentialContenders.name: Jenny Rissveds
potentialContenders.note: Rio 2016 champion, Paris 2024 bronze medalist, 2025 world champion and 2026 World Cup overall winner, the first Swede to take the elite series. A strong contender.

potentialContenders.name: Haley Batten
potentialContenders.note: Paris 2024 silver medalist, 10th at the 2026 worlds, and would race on home soil in 2028 if she makes the team. The crowd favorite.

potentialContenders.name: Martina Berta
potentialContenders.note: Second at the 2026 worlds and just edged by Frei in the Lake Placid finale. A dark horse who could be on the podium.

potentialContenders.name: Pauline Ferrand-Prévot
potentialContenders.note: Paris 2024 champion who has returned to road racing. She calls 2028 a long-term goal, but at least one report puts that target on the road, so a start here is uncertain.

OWS01.blurb:
Sharon van Rouwendaal won this race in 2016 and again in Paris, then retired in September 2025. For the first time in a dozen years, the women's 10km will crown a champion nobody has seen win it before.

The woman who chased her home in Paris may be the one to take over. Moesha Johnson of Australia won the 2025 world title, swept every 10km on the 2026 World Cup circuit, and won the Pan Pacs 10km off Long Beach in August 2026. If she makes the team, she arrives having already beaten this water.

Expect a morning race off Belmont Shore, with swimmers inside the Breakwater and fans lining the sand and the area around the pier. Two hours of tactics, drafting and a final sprint, all in sight of the beach.
OWS01.potentialContendersIntro: Van Rouwendaal's retirement leaves the title open. These swimmers are projected contenders based on 2025-2026 form; none has qualified for 2028 yet.

potentialContenders.name: Moesha Johnson
potentialContenders.note: Paris 2024 silver medalist and 2025 world champion. She won the 2026 Pan Pacs 10km off Long Beach and every 10km on the 2026 World Cup circuit. Projected favorite if she qualifies.

potentialContenders.name: Ginevra Taddeucci
potentialContenders.note: Paris 2024 bronze medalist and 2025 World Cup overall champion. She took silver behind Johnson at the 2025 Worlds and won the 2026 European 10km title. Likely contender if she qualifies.

potentialContenders.name: Ichika Kajimoto
potentialContenders.note: Ranked No. 2 in the world entering the 2026 Pan Pacs, according to SwimSwam, and a finalist there off Long Beach. Could emerge as a medal threat.

potentialContenders.name: Airi Ebina
potentialContenders.note: Runner-up to Johnson at the 2026 Pan Pacs in Long Beach and again in Cancun that November. A projected challenger if she qualifies.

potentialContenders.name: Lisa Pou
potentialContenders.note: 2025 world 10km bronze medalist. Tied for sixth at the 2026 European Championships, so her form is worth watching.

OWS02.blurb:
Florian Wellbrock has the pool résumé of a middle-distance star and the open water record to match. He won the 2025 world 10km, then a first European title in the Seine with a late sprint. In August 2026 he won off Long Beach in 1:49:51. If he qualifies, the man to beat has already won on this course.

But this race rarely follows form. Hungary's David Betlehem, the Paris bronze medalist, won World Cup races in Ibiza and Setubal in 2026 and finished just 2.90 seconds behind Wellbrock in Cancun. Gregorio Paltrinieri keeps lurking, and Paris champion Kristof Rasovszky has shown he can lead from the front.

Picture a late-morning pack churning inside the Breakwater, the beach crowd leaning in as the lead group hits the final stretch. Gaps here can come down to a hand's length.
OWS02.potentialContendersIntro: None of these swimmers has qualified or confirmed a 2028 entry; they are projected contenders based on 2025-2026 form, plus the reigning Paris champion.

potentialContenders.name: Florian Wellbrock
potentialContenders.note: Tokyo 2020 champion and 2025 world 10km champion. He won the 2026 Pan Pacs off Long Beach and the 2026/27 World Cup opener in Cancun. Ranked No. 1 by SwimSwam in August 2026; projected favorite.

potentialContenders.name: Dávid Betlehem

potentialContenders.name: Gregorio Paltrinieri

potentialContenders.name: Kristóf Rasovszky
potentialContenders.note: Paris 2024 champion. He led much of the 2026 European 10km before finishing 23rd. A title defense would require a rebound.

potentialContenders.name: Oliver Klemet
potentialContenders.note: Paris 2024 silver medalist, third at the 2026 European 10km. Could be a second German threat alongside Wellbrock.

RCB01.blurb:
Start with the surf. At the 2026 world finals in Qingdao, storms wiped out the opening weekend and the time trials were rowed through heavy breakers, with boats flipping all over the course. Coastal rowing at Belmont Shore will be just as unforgiving, and nobody has rowed it on the ocean at a Games before.

This morning sets the knockout draw, and the draw is not destiny. Samuel Forbes was only seventh in those Qingdao time trials, then went on to take men's solo silver. Watch the sprint across the sand, the lunge into the water and the slalom around the buoys.

Fans line the shoreline and the area around the pier, so you can follow every dash and capsize from the beach.
RCB01.potentialContendersIntro: These are the men's and women's solo names to watch, based on recent world finals. Nobody is confirmed for 2028, since places are decided mainly in Oeiras in October 2027.

potentialContenders.name: Moritz Wolff
potentialContenders.note: Set the fastest men's solo time trial at the 2026 world finals, 3.3 seconds ahead of Chris Bak, and was fastest in 2025 too. He took bronze in 2026, so the question is whether his seeding speed becomes a medal.

potentialContenders.name: Chris Bak
potentialContenders.note: Four-time beach sprint world champion and the most decorated beach sprinter so far. He won the men's solo in 2024 and 2025, and is a likely contender if the US qualifies.

potentialContenders.name: Isabella Scammell
potentialContenders.note: Won the 2026 women's solo time trial by seven seconds, then the world title, Australia's first gold at any Beach Sprint Finals. She is projected to be among the women's favorites.

potentialContenders.name: Magdalena Lobnig
potentialContenders.note: Won the 2024 world title, then silver in 2025 and bronze in 2026. Her podium streak makes her a threat, if she qualifies.

potentialContenders.name: Samuel Forbes
potentialContenders.note: The 20-year-old was seventh in the 2026 time trials, then won silver, which makes him a good example of why seeding doesn't decide the knockouts.

RCB02.blurb:
Chris Bak has won more beach sprint world golds than anyone, and in Qingdao he still lost. Samuel Forbes knocked him out in the quarterfinals. Then Liu Jiayu, 21, won the title even though his sliding seat came loose in the final.

That's what you get from a race this short, with a sprint on sand, a slalom through surf and a sprint back. One missed buzzer or one wrong turn around a buoy decides it. Isabella Scammell's quarterfinal opponent missed the start buzzer in 2026, and Magdalena Lobnig went the wrong way around a buoy in her semifinal.

The finals of the first coastal rowing medals at a Games, on the shore at Belmont Shore, will be loud and close, and very hard to predict.
RCB02.potentialContendersIntro: The finals will feature the women's and men's solo medalists. Based on recent world finals, these are projected contenders, though none is confirmed for 2028.

potentialContenders.name: Chris Bak
potentialContenders.note: Four-time world champion with six World Rowing Beach Sprint Finals medals and nobody has more golds. He won the first US beach sprint gold in 2022, and was knocked out in the 2026 quarterfinals.

potentialContenders.name: Liu Jiayu
potentialContenders.note: Won the 2026 men's solo world title at 21, China's first, despite a sliding seat that came loose in the final. He is a rising contender if China qualifies.

potentialContenders.name: Samuel Forbes
potentialContenders.note: Silver medalist in 2026, and he knocked Bak out in the quarterfinals on the way.

potentialContenders.name: Isabella Scammell
potentialContenders.note: 2026 women's solo world champion, ahead of Zhu Wenjie. Likely a favorite if she makes the Australian team.

potentialContenders.name: Magdalena Lobnig
potentialContenders.note: On the world podium three years in a row, with gold in 2024, silver in 2025 and bronze in 2026. A veteran who could still reach the final if she qualifies.

RCB03.blurb:
Germany did something smart in Qingdao. It split up its European champions, Julia Tertuente and Moritz Wolff, to row solos, and put Franz Werner with Sophie Leupold in the mixed double. They won the world title, and Leupold admitted they'd nearly been eliminated the day before the final.

That's the nature of this event. Two athletes sprint the sand, launch together, row through the buoys and run home, and every crew has a way to fall apart. Nations can also enter different athletes than those who earned the quota place, so crew chemistry will be a mystery until race day.

This is the first mixed-gender rowing event at a Games, so these time trials are your first look at the new format on the Belmont Shore ocean course.
RCB03.potentialContendersIntro: These are the mixed double crews to watch, based on recent world finals and the 2026 Youth Games. Nothing is confirmed for 2028, and crews may change.

potentialContenders.name: Franz Werner / Sophie Leupold
potentialContenders.note: 2026 world champions and Germany's first world title in an open beach sprint class. Projected to be near the front, but their near-elimination shows how thin the margins are.

potentialContenders.name: Dominykas Jancionis / Martyna Kazlauskaite
potentialContenders.note: Won mixed double world gold in 2024 and 2025, then finished second in 2026. They are likely contenders if Lithuania qualifies.

potentialContenders.name: Isabella Scammell / Oscar Scheel Gambo
potentialContenders.note: Won the 2026 mixed double time trial. Scammell also won the women's solo, so watch whether she doubles up for Australia.

potentialContenders.name: Su Juntao / Liu Lili
potentialContenders.note: Won the mixed double at the 2026 Youth Games in Dakar and the under-19 title at the 2026 world finals. A young crew who could break through.

RCB04.blurb:
The first medals ever awarded in a mixed-gender rowing event will be decided in a finish sprint. That's how Germany beat two-time champions Lithuania in Qingdao, with Franz Werner and Sophie Leupold winning by outrunning Martyna Kazlauskaite and Dominykas Jancionis to the line.

Everything comes down to the last 100 meters and the run up the beach, where a stumble matters. Chris Bak did the finish run in the USA's silver-medal boat in 2025, and Wolff tripped on the beach run in a 2025 solo semifinal. Nobody is safe.

Stand on the sand at Belmont Shore and the finish line is right in front of you. Two rowers will cross it first and take a place in Games history.
RCB04.potentialContendersIntro: These are the mixed double crews that have medaled at recent world finals. Nothing is confirmed for 2028, because places are decided mainly in Oeiras in October 2027.

potentialContenders.name: Franz Werner / Sophie Leupold
potentialContenders.note: 2026 world champions, beating Lithuania in the finish sprint. If they are on the 2028 team, they could be the crew to beat.

potentialContenders.name: Dominykas Jancionis / Martyna Kazlauskaite
potentialContenders.note: Won mixed double world gold in 2024 and 2025, then silver in 2026. They are the most proven pair in this field.

potentialContenders.name: Ander Martin
potentialContenders.note: Two mixed double world golds and a bronze, plus 2025 men's solo silver and European men's solo champion. A likely threat in a Spanish boat if Spain qualifies.

potentialContenders.name: Chris Bak
potentialContenders.note: Sprinted the finish run in the USA's 2025 mixed double silver. If the US qualifies a mixed boat, he could appear.

potentialContenders.name: Su Juntao / Liu Lili
potentialContenders.note: Won the first mixed double final at the 2026 Youth Games in Dakar, 6.58 seconds ahead of Austria. They could be a surprise crew in 2028.

ROW01.blurb:
Fiona Murtagh won the 2025 world title in Shanghai in 7:12.27, and if the Irish sculler makes the line-up, this is where her regatta could begin. The women's single sculls heats open the 2028 Games on a Saturday afternoon, with Paris 2024 champion Karolien Florijn among the names the field will be hunting.

The venue is half the story. Marine Stadium was dredged for the 1932 Games, a long, narrow saltwater channel where spectators stand at the shoreline right beside the lanes, with Belmont Shore and the Long Beach skyline behind them.

Men's double sculls and pair heats fill out the session, and the reigning Paris golds from Romania and Croatia are the targets. Over a first-ever 1,500 metres, a slow start is harder to fix.
ROW01.potentialContendersIntro: The women's single sculls heats are the headline. Murtagh is the reigning world champion, and the rest of the projected field is speculative until qualification wraps up.

potentialContenders.name: Fiona Murtagh
potentialContenders.note: 2025 world champion in Shanghai in 7:12.27. She would be a favorite if she qualifies.

potentialContenders.name: Karolien Florijn
potentialContenders.note: Paris 2024 gold medalist. Her 2028 plans are unconfirmed, but a defense of the title would add edge to every heat.

potentialContenders.name: Lauren Henry
potentialContenders.note: Silver at the 2025 worlds, behind Murtagh. A likely contender for the final.

potentialContenders.name: Frida Sanggaard Nielsen
potentialContenders.note: Bronze at the 2025 worlds. Could be a medal threat if she qualifies.

ROW02.blurb:
Three men have traded the top spot in the men's single sculls since Paris. Oliver Zeidler won there. Stefanos Ntouskos then beat him at the 2025 worlds in 6:36.75, with Zalaty third. Zeidler took a world title again in 2026. Sunday morning's heats are where the sequel starts.

Thirty nations sent a sculler to the 2025 worlds, so expect unfamiliar names mixed in with the stars. The men's double sculls and pair semifinals raise the stakes on the same stretch of water, while the women's double and pair heats begin their run toward Monday and Tuesday.

At Marine Stadium you stand at the shoreline, close enough to hear the catch and the shouts. A 9 AM start gives you the chance to see a champion working in the first round.
ROW02.potentialContendersIntro: The men's single sculls heats are the marquee event. Paris 2024 and recent worlds results give a strong guide, but 2028 line-ups are not set.

potentialContenders.name: Stefanos Ntouskos
potentialContenders.note: 2025 world champion in Shanghai in 6:36.75. He is projected to be a top contender if he qualifies.

potentialContenders.name: Oliver Zeidler
potentialContenders.note: Paris 2024 gold medalist and a 2026 world champion. A likely favorite if he is in the field.

potentialContenders.name: Yauheni Zalaty
potentialContenders.note: Paris 2024 silver medalist and 2025 world bronze medalist. His 2028 eligibility and flag are unconfirmed, but he has been a constant medal threat.

ROW03.blurb:
The first medals of the regatta are handed out before lunch. The men's double sculls and pair A finals arrive on Monday morning, so the first national anthem could ring across the channel from boats that were warming up an hour earlier.

The doubles pit the reigning Paris champions from Romania against the Dutch, who took silver. Simon van Dorp, a Paris single sculls bronze medalist, won the 2026 world title in the double, so his crew will be one to watch. In the pair, Croatia's Paris gold set the standard.

The women's single sculls quarterfinals and women's double and pair semifinals add depth. Over 1,500 metres, the margin between a medal and a B final can be a few strokes.
ROW03.potentialContendersIntro: The men's double sculls and pair finals are the medal races. Crews listed below come from Paris 2024 and 2026 worlds results, and 2028 line-ups are projections.

potentialContenders.name: Simon van Dorp
potentialContenders.note: Won the 2026 world title in the men's double sculls. He could lead a Dutch challenge if he is in the boat.

potentialContenders.name: Andrei Cornea and Marian Enache
potentialContenders.note: Paris 2024 gold medalists in the men's double. Their 2028 participation is unconfirmed.

potentialContenders.name: Martin and Valent Sinković
potentialContenders.note: Paris 2024 gold medalists in the men's pair. If they continue, Croatia is the benchmark.

potentialContenders.name: Melvin Twellaar and Stefan Broenink
potentialContenders.note: Paris 2024 silver medalists in the men's double. A possible 2028 factor if the pairing survives.

ROW04.blurb:
Gold, silver and bronze in two women's events are decided in under three hours. The women's double sculls and pair finals bring Romania and the Netherlands back into the spotlight, with New Zealand's Paris double champions and a United States pair that won bronze at the 2026 worlds as part of the chase.

A world best time in the women's pair at the 2026 worlds shows how fast the boats are. If a crew gets off the line well at 1,500 metres, it could be tough to catch.

Meanwhile the men's quad and four heats sort out contenders, and the men's single sculls quarterfinals put Oliver Zeidler and Stefanos Ntouskos one step closer to the weekend's final. The United States four, Paris gold and 2026 world champions, is one to circle.
ROW04.potentialContendersIntro: The women's double sculls and pair finals are the medal races. These crews are projected from Paris 2024 and 2026 worlds results, so 2028 line-ups are not set.

potentialContenders.name: Netherlands women's pair
potentialContenders.note: Paris 2024 gold medalists. A projected contender if the crew stays together.

potentialContenders.name: Romania women's pair
potentialContenders.note: Paris 2024 silver medalists. They have been persistent challengers to the Dutch.

potentialContenders.name: New Zealand women's double
potentialContenders.note: Paris 2024 gold medalists. A defense of the title would depend on qualification and line-up.

potentialContenders.name: Romania women's double
potentialContenders.note: Paris 2024 silver medalists, and a likely podium threat.

potentialContenders.name: United States women's pair
potentialContenders.note: Bronze at the 2026 worlds. They could be a home-crowd medal threat.

ROW05.blurb:
Two of the strongest men's crews in the world race for gold on Wednesday morning. The United States four won Paris 2024 and again at the 2026 worlds in Amsterdam, and a home-water A final would be a first for them. In the quad, the Netherlands, Paris champions, would take on a German crew that won a heat at the 2026 worlds in 6:16.11.

Before those races, the women's single sculls semifinals narrow the field. Fiona Murtagh, the 2025 world champion, is the one to watch if she qualifies. The women's quad and four heats begin the buildup to Thursday's finals.

It's an early, compact session. The boats come down the channel one after another, the shoreline crowd leans in, and the first medal races of the crew boats come and go quickly.
ROW05.potentialContendersIntro: The men's quadruple sculls and men's four A finals are the headline medal races. These crews are projected from Paris 2024 and worlds results, and 2028 line-ups are speculative.

potentialContenders.name: United States men's four
potentialContenders.note: Paris 2024 gold medalists and 2026 world champions. They would be favorites at home if the line-up holds.

potentialContenders.name: Netherlands men's quad
potentialContenders.note: Paris 2024 gold medalists. Could contend again if the crew is intact.

potentialContenders.name: Germany men's quad
potentialContenders.note: Won heat 2 at the 2026 worlds in 6:16.11. A likely finalist.

ROW06.blurb:
Six minutes and nine seconds. That is how fast the United States women's four went at the 2026 worlds in Amsterdam, a world best time on the way to the title. Thursday morning's A final could bring that crew back to take on the Dutch, who won Paris 2024.

The women's quad is just as intriguing. Great Britain won gold in Paris, the Netherlands took silver, and the United States took bronze at the 2026 worlds.

Men's eight heats begin the run toward Friday's final, with the Dutch, world champions in 2025, among the early targets. The men's single sculls semifinals hand out the last finalist places, so the opening races have plenty of drama too.
ROW06.potentialContendersIntro: The women's four and women's quadruple sculls A finals are the medal races. These crews are projected from Paris 2024 and 2026 worlds results.

potentialContenders.name: United States women's four
potentialContenders.note: 2026 world champions in a world best 6:09.87. They could be the favorites at home if the line-up holds.

potentialContenders.name: Netherlands women's four
potentialContenders.note: Paris 2024 gold medalists. A projected rival to the United States.

potentialContenders.name: Great Britain women's quad
potentialContenders.note: Paris 2024 gold medalists. A likely contender if the crew stays together.

potentialContenders.name: Netherlands women's quad
potentialContenders.note: Paris 2024 silver medalists, and a possible medal threat again.

potentialContenders.name: United States women's quad
potentialContenders.note: Bronze at the 2026 worlds. A home-water medal chance.

ROW07.blurb:
Eight rowers and a coxswain, a long boat and the loudest finale of the regatta. The men's eight A final puts the Netherlands, world champions in 2025 and 2026, up against Great Britain, the Paris 2024 gold medalists. The Dutch crew has included Finn Florijn, Wibout Rustenburg and coxswain Jonna de Vries.

The United States, third at the 2025 worlds, and Australia, third in 2026, could crash the party. At 1,500 metres there is less time to claw back from a bad start.

The women's single sculls A to D finals add another medal race, with Fiona Murtagh and Karolien Florijn among the names to watch. The women's eight heats set up the closing day.
ROW07.potentialContendersIntro: The men's eight A final is the marquee race. These crews come from Paris 2024 and recent worlds results, and 2028 rosters are speculative.

potentialContenders.name: Netherlands
potentialContenders.note: Won the 2025 and 2026 world titles and took Paris 2024 silver. They are projected favorites if the crew holds.

potentialContenders.name: Great Britain
potentialContenders.note: Paris 2024 gold medalists and 2025 and 2026 world silver medalists. A likely contender.

potentialContenders.name: United States
potentialContenders.note: Bronze at the 2025 worlds. They could be a home-water threat.

potentialContenders.name: Australia
potentialContenders.note: Bronze at the 2026 worlds. A possible podium crasher.

ROW08.blurb:
The regatta ends with a single scull. Oliver Zeidler, the Paris 2024 gold medalist, could face Stefanos Ntouskos, who beat him at the 2025 worlds, in the men's single sculls A final if both qualify. One scull, one rower, 1,500 metres and a Saturday-morning finale.

The women's eight A final follows. Romania won Paris 2024 and the 2026 world title, with the United States taking bronze at the 2026 worlds, so a home-water challenge is plausible.

It is the last chance to stand on the Marine Stadium shoreline, and the first time since 1932 to see the closing races of a Los Angeles regatta.
ROW08.potentialContendersIntro: The men's single sculls A final is the featured race. These scullers are projected from Paris 2024 and recent worlds results, and 2028 line-ups are not set.

potentialContenders.name: Oliver Zeidler
potentialContenders.note: Paris 2024 gold medalist and a 2026 world champion. A likely favorite if he is in the field.

potentialContenders.name: Stefanos Ntouskos
potentialContenders.note: 2025 world champion in 6:36.75. He could be the main threat to Zeidler.

potentialContenders.name: Yauheni Zalaty
potentialContenders.note: Paris 2024 silver medalist and 2025 world bronze medalist. His 2028 eligibility and flag are unconfirmed.

potentialContenders.name: Simon van Dorp
potentialContenders.note: Paris 2024 bronze medalist in the single sculls. He won the 2026 double sculls title, so a return to the single in 2028 is speculative.

RU701.blurb:
New Zealand against Australia is the rivalry that defines this sport right now. The two met in all six 2025/26 regular-season finals, New Zealand winning five, before Australia took the 2026 World Championship 26-19 in Bordeaux.

You won't get that final on a Wednesday morning. You get something else: twelve teams, six matches, and the first look at who has arrived in form and who is still finding their feet.

The stadium holds about 27,000 and every seat sits close to the field. Get in early, find a spot near the touchline, and listen to the collisions carry in the morning air.
RU701.potentialContendersIntro: The field isn't set. Qualification runs through 2027 and a June 2028 repechage, so these are likely names based on recent form.

potentialContenders.name: New Zealand
potentialContenders.note: Paris 2024 and Tokyo champion, and 2025/26 SVNS regular-season winner. They are chasing a third straight title if they qualify.

potentialContenders.name: Australia
potentialContenders.note: 2026 World Championship winners, 26-19 over New Zealand in Bordeaux. Maddison Levi was Player of the Final.

potentialContenders.name: Canada
potentialContenders.note: Paris 2024 silver medalist and third at the 2026 World Championship. A likely knockout-stage threat.

potentialContenders.name: United States
potentialContenders.note: Qualifies automatically as host and is the Paris 2024 bronze medalist, which makes a loud home crowd a near-certainty.

RU702.blurb:
The sun drops, the stands fill, and the home crowd gets its first real shot at making noise. The United States, bronze medalist in Paris and host this time, could well play under these evening conditions.

Ilona Maher is the subplot. She is 30, spent a year away, and says she is rebuilding toward contact readiness. She has said nothing is guaranteed, so if she makes the team, every touch will draw a reaction.

The U.S. women finished third on the 2025/26 series, while New Zealand and Australia keep trading blows at the top. Evening pool play is where you can catch that whole picture in one sitting.
RU702.potentialContendersIntro: These are projected pool-play teams. Draws and the full 2028 field are not yet known.

potentialContenders.name: United States
potentialContenders.note: Host nation and Paris 2024 bronze medalist. Third on the 2025/26 SVNS series and fourth at the 2026 World Championship, with a second-place finish in Valladolid.

potentialContenders.name: New Zealand
potentialContenders.note: Won the last two titles at the Games and the 2025/26 regular-season crown. The benchmark everyone chases.

potentialContenders.name: Australia
potentialContenders.note: 2026 World Championship winners and a perennial finalist. They will be dangerous if they qualify, which looks likely.

potentialContenders.name: Canada
potentialContenders.note: Paris 2024 silver medalist who beat the U.S. for third in Bordeaux. A likely contender.

RU703.blurb:
This is the morning of calculators and scoreboards. Everyone has played twice, and whoever slips here drops into the 9-12 bracket while the rest go straight into the quarterfinals that afternoon.

After two days of group play, the pecking order sharpens. Canada took third at the 2026 World Championship, beating the United States in the Bordeaux playoff. Australia is still carrying the memory of losing the Paris bronze match 14-12 on a late American try.

In a stadium this compact, you can watch the wingers race down the line from just a few rows back. Teams that need a result will play like it.
RU703.potentialContendersIntro: No pools exist yet, so these are teams likely to be fighting for quarterfinal spots, based on 2026 form.

potentialContenders.name: Canada
potentialContenders.note: Third at the 2026 World Championship, their best result of the season under coach Jocelyn Barrieau. Likely contenders if they qualify.

potentialContenders.name: Australia
potentialContenders.note: Fourth at Paris 2024 and 2026 world champions. Expected to arrive with a point to prove.

potentialContenders.name: United States
potentialContenders.note: Host side that lost the Bordeaux bronze playoff to Canada. A strong home crowd could swing tight pool finishes.

potentialContenders.name: New Zealand
potentialContenders.note: The defending champion and projected top seed. Pool play is about avoiding upsets before the knockouts.

RU704.blurb:
Lose and you drop into the 5-8 bracket. Win and you are one match away from the semifinals. Four quarterfinals in three hours make this the first session where every match has real heat.

The recent history is spicy. Canada beat the United States 19-7 in a quarterfinal at Hong Kong in April 2026 and beat Fiji 29-14 in a Bordeaux quarterfinal two months later. If those two meet again with a home crowd roaring, the stadium will feel it.

New Zealand, meanwhile, is going for a third straight title. This is where that quest starts to bite.
RU704.potentialContendersIntro: The quarterfinal lineup depends on pool results, so these are projected names based on Paris 2024 and 2026 form.

potentialContenders.name: New Zealand
potentialContenders.note: Gold at Tokyo and Paris 2024, and 2025/26 regular-season champions. They are the team to beat for a third straight title.

potentialContenders.name: Canada
potentialContenders.note: Paris 2024 silver medalist. Beat the U.S. 19-7 in Hong Kong 2026 and Fiji 29-14 in Bordeaux.

potentialContenders.name: United States
potentialContenders.note: Host and Paris bronze medalist. Finished fourth at the 2026 World Championship, so quarterfinal revenge is a likely storyline.

potentialContenders.name: Australia
potentialContenders.note: 2026 world champions and Paris 2024 fourth-place finishers. A likely quarterfinalist.

RU705.blurb:
Two matches decide who plays for gold. Everyone else spends the evening on the bronze match, and the semifinal loser knows it.

Past semifinals have given this sport some of its best theater. In Paris, New Zealand and Canada advanced while the United States lost, then recovered for bronze. In Bordeaux in 2026, Australia beat the Americans in the semifinals on its way to the world title.

Saturday afternoon is the sweet spot: sun low, crowd settled, nerves visible. If Ilona Maher makes the roster, a semifinal of this size is the stage her return was built for.
RU705.potentialContendersIntro: The semifinal field isn't set. These are likely stars based on Paris 2024 and 2026 form, and their selection is not confirmed.

potentialContenders.name: Maddison Levi
potentialContenders.note: Player of the Final in Australia's 26-19 win over New Zealand at the 2026 World Championship. Likely a focal point if selected.

potentialContenders.name: Michaela Blyde
potentialContenders.note: Part of New Zealand's Paris 2024 gold-medal side. Could appear if she stays in the squad.

potentialContenders.name: Charity Williams
potentialContenders.note: Part of Canada's Paris 2024 silver-medal team. Could be central to another run if selected.

potentialContenders.name: Ilona Maher
potentialContenders.note: Returning to rugby and aiming for selection, but she has said nothing is guaranteed. Her Paris 2024 bronze made her a star.

RU706.blurb:
New Zealand trailed Australia 21-5 in the March 2026 New York final and still won 22-21. That is the kind of match this rivalry produces, and it could be the final here.

There is plenty on the line. New Zealand can win a third straight title after Tokyo and Paris. Australia won the first women's gold at Rio 2016 and is the reigning world champion. Canada and the United States can fight over bronze first.

These are the first rugby medals of the 2028 Games. With night settling over Carson and a crowd of up to 27,000 inches from the touchlines, nothing about the evening will feel small.
RU706.potentialContendersIntro: Finalists are unknown. These are projected medal contenders based on Paris 2024 and 2026 results, and none are confirmed for the team.

potentialContenders.name: Maddison Levi
potentialContenders.note: Player of the Final in Australia's 2026 World Championship win. Could be the player who decides the gold medal match.

potentialContenders.name: Michaela Blyde
potentialContenders.note: Paris 2024 gold medalist with New Zealand. Likely a go-to attacker if she makes the squad.

potentialContenders.name: Ilona Maher
potentialContenders.note: Aiming to return and make the roster after a year away. A bronze-medal match is a plausible stage for her.

potentialContenders.name: Charity Williams
potentialContenders.note: Paris 2024 silver medalist who could be in the fight for gold or bronze if selected.

RU707.blurb:
A new tournament begins. For the first time the women have already finished, so the men arrive at a stadium that has had four days to warm up.

The defending champion is France, which beat Fiji 28-7 in Paris. The favorite, though, may be South Africa, which won the 2026 World Championship and four of six regular-season events in 2025/26. Fiji, two-time champion before Paris, still sits in the background.

Sunday morning in Carson is about first impressions. Watch for the team that looks sharp from the opening whistle.
RU707.potentialContendersIntro: Pools aren't drawn and the field isn't final. These are projected teams based on Paris 2024 and 2026 results.

potentialContenders.name: South Africa
potentialContenders.note: 2026 World Championship winners and Paris 2024 bronze medalists. They won four of six 2025/26 regular-season events.

potentialContenders.name: France
potentialContenders.note: Paris 2024 champions, 28-7 over Fiji, and the winners at Bordeaux 2026. They arrive as defending champions.

potentialContenders.name: Fiji
potentialContenders.note: Champions at Rio 2016 and Tokyo and Paris 2024 silver medalists. Coach Osea Kolinisau's tenure runs through 2028.

potentialContenders.name: United States
potentialContenders.note: Host nation that has never won a men's sevens medal at the Games. It finished fifth at Bordeaux 2026.

RU708.blurb:
One question hangs over this evening: will Antoine Dupont be here? He scored two tries and set up a third in the Paris final, then said in June 2026 that a sevens return appeals to him but that he'll first target the 2027 Rugby World Cup.

Even without him, France is a threat. They beat South Africa 21-12 in the semifinals and New Zealand 14-5 in the final at Bordeaux 2026.

Fiji will be out to atone. The side that won gold in Rio and Tokyo watched France lift the trophy last time, and the Fijian game has a way of finding fireworks under lights.
RU708.potentialContendersIntro: Evening pool matchups aren't known. These are projected teams, and Dupont's participation is still speculation.

potentialContenders.name: France
potentialContenders.note: Defending champions and Bordeaux 2026 winners. Antoine Dupont could return to sevens if his body and schedule allow.

potentialContenders.name: Fiji
potentialContenders.note: Paris 2024 silver medalists, 28-7 losers to France. The defeat was their first at the Games.

potentialContenders.name: South Africa
potentialContenders.note: 2026 world champions who lost to France in the Bordeaux semifinal. Likely contenders.

potentialContenders.name: New Zealand
potentialContenders.note: Runner-up to France at Bordeaux 2026. A likely quarterfinal threat if they qualify.

potentialContenders.name: United States
potentialContenders.note: Host with a home crowd and a fifth-place finish at Bordeaux 2026. They are chasing a first men's medal.

RU709.blurb:
By Monday morning, the margin between a quarterfinal berth and the 9-12 bracket can come down to a single try. That makes the last pool session a good bet for tension without a medal on the line.

The United States arrived at Bordeaux 2026 and won all three pool matches against Australia, Spain and Uruguay, finishing fifth. Argentina, second in the standings before Bordeaux, lost to France and New Zealand there and played for ninth. Pool play can turn on one bad afternoon.

From a seat near the field, you can see which teams are tightening up and which are hunting for the next score.
RU709.potentialContendersIntro: Pools are unknown. These teams are likely to be in play for quarterfinal places based on 2026 form.

potentialContenders.name: United States
potentialContenders.note: Host nation that won all three Bordeaux 2026 pool matches. A fifth-place finish suggests it can play with the leaders.

potentialContenders.name: Argentina
potentialContenders.note: Second in the 2026 standings before Bordeaux, where they lost to France and New Zealand. A dangerous side if they qualify.

potentialContenders.name: Australia
potentialContenders.note: Beat South Africa in the Valladolid 2026 final. Likely quarterfinal material if qualified.

potentialContenders.name: Spain
potentialContenders.note: Third at Bordeaux 2026. Could be a surprise contender if they qualify.

RU710.blurb:
Eight teams in the main bracket, four of them going home from the medal race. If the United States gets here, it plays in front of a home crowd that has never seen a men's sevens medal at the Games.

South Africa clinched the 2026 World Championship by beating Fiji in a Bordeaux quarterfinal, while Australia fell out of title contention with a quarterfinal loss there. That's how quickly the top of this sport can turn.

Monday evening in Carson comes with a chill in the shadows and a lot of anxious scoreboard-watching. Every match is a possible elimination.
RU710.potentialContendersIntro: The quarterfinal teams will come from pool results. These are projected contenders based on 2026 form.

potentialContenders.name: South Africa
potentialContenders.note: 2026 world champions who beat Fiji in the Bordeaux quarterfinals. They are a leading contender.

potentialContenders.name: Fiji
potentialContenders.note: Paris 2024 silver medalists and a team that always plays with pace. They are likely quarterfinal threats.

potentialContenders.name: France
potentialContenders.note: Defending champions and Bordeaux 2026 winners. They are likely to be among the top seeds.

potentialContenders.name: United States
potentialContenders.note: Host side that finished fifth at Bordeaux 2026. A home crowd will push them in any quarterfinal.

potentialContenders.name: Australia
potentialContenders.note: Won the Valladolid 2026 final over South Africa, but lost in the Bordeaux quarterfinals. They could bounce back.

RU711.blurb:
One afternoon, two semifinals, and two shots at the gold medal match. The losers drop to the bronze match, but nobody who gets this far wants that.

South Africa, Fiji, France and New Zealand are projected contenders. South Africa won the 2026 World Championship and the 2025/26 series, while France beat South Africa 21-12 in the Bordeaux semifinal. Fiji lost to South Africa in the New York final and again in the Bordeaux quarterfinal.

If Antoine Dupont decides to come back, this is the kind of match that would test whether he can still drive a game.
RU711.potentialContendersIntro: Semifinalists aren't known. These are projected stars, and nothing is confirmed about selection.

potentialContenders.name: Antoine Dupont
potentialContenders.note: Scored twice in the Paris 2024 final. He has said a 2028 return appeals to him but will first prepare for the 2027 Rugby World Cup.

potentialContenders.name: Selvyn Davids
potentialContenders.note: South African playmaker from the Paris 2024 bronze-medal side. Could be a key figure if selected.

potentialContenders.name: Waisea Nacuqu
potentialContenders.note: Fijian back who played in Paris 2024. Could be part of Fiji's push if selected.

potentialContenders.name: Terry Kennedy
potentialContenders.note: Part of France's Paris 2024 gold-medal squad. A likely contender if he makes the team.

RU712.blurb:
This is the last rugby session of the 2028 Games, and the gold medal match is last on the card. France is the defending champion after a 28-7 win over Fiji, the host nation's first gold of Paris 2024.

Fiji came into that final unbeaten at the Games after Rio and Tokyo, and Osea Kolinisau's contract runs through 2028. South Africa, the bronze medalist in Paris, won the 2026 World Championship and the 2025/26 series, beating Fiji 10-7 in New York.

The United States, host nation, has never won a men's sevens medal at the Games. If it gets here, expect the stands to be louder than anywhere else in the tournament.
RU712.potentialContendersIntro: Finalists are unknown. These are projected stars based on Paris 2024 and 2026 form, and none are confirmed.

potentialContenders.name: Antoine Dupont
potentialContenders.note: Two tries in the Paris 2024 final. He has said a 2028 sevens return appeals to him after the 2027 Rugby World Cup.

potentialContenders.name: Selvyn Davids
potentialContenders.note: South African creator from the Paris 2024 bronze-medal team. Could lead the 2026 world champions if selected.

potentialContenders.name: Waisea Nacuqu
potentialContenders.note: Fijian back who played in Paris 2024. Could be part of a rebound campaign if selected.

potentialContenders.name: Terry Kennedy
potentialContenders.note: Paris 2024 gold medalist with France. A likely contender in a title defense if he makes the squad.

SAL01.blurb:
The first look at the kite fleet comes before anyone is fighting for a medal, and that is the appeal. Max Maeder arrives as a three-time world champion after winning the 2026 Worlds in Portugal. Lauriane Nolot, the Paris 2024 silver medalist, owns three world titles of her own.

The racing runs close to the beach at Belmont Shore, so you can watch from the sand near Belmont Veterans Memorial Pier without a telescope. Kites snap overhead while riders skim offshore on foils.

Long Beach also hosted sailing in 1984. Day one is a chance to see who looks sharp early, including Daniela Moroz, the top North American at the 2026 Worlds.
SAL01.potentialContendersIntro: Qualifying is open to the full kite fleet, but form from the 2026 Formula Kite Worlds points to a few likely names. Who actually makes the 2028 start lines is still to be decided.

potentialContenders.name: Max Maeder
potentialContenders.note: Paris 2024 bronze medalist and 2026 world champion, his third world title. He is the likely man to beat if he qualifies.

potentialContenders.name: Lauriane Nolot
potentialContenders.note: Paris 2024 silver medalist who won her third world title in 2026 and the 2026 European title. A likely women's favorite.

potentialContenders.name: Daniela Moroz
potentialContenders.note: Six-time world champion who finished fourth at the 2026 Worlds, top among North Americans. A potential home-crowd favorite if she makes the team.

potentialContenders.name: Riccardo Pianosi
potentialContenders.note: 2025 world champion who placed fifth at the 2026 Worlds, a contender worth watching in the men's fleet.

SAL02.blurb:
Two disciplines share this session, and one of them is changing. Windsurfing opens with the iQFOiL class racing on resized sails: 8 square meters for the men and a newly designed 7.3 for the women. The class says the change should make the field fairer across body types.

Expect the new gear to shape early results. Tamar Steinberg and Luuc van Opzeeland won the 2026 world titles, and a fleet of 186 windsurfers from 41 nations raced in Weymouth.

Meanwhile the kite fleet is back for its second qualifying day. At the 2026 Worlds, Jessie Kampman led the women after qualifying and Max Maeder led the men.
SAL02.potentialContendersIntro: This session covers windsurfing's opening day and the second day of kite qualifying. The contenders below are for windsurfing, based on 2026 form. The 2028 fields are not set.

potentialContenders.name: Tamar Steinberg
potentialContenders.note: 2026 iQFOiL world and European champion. She is a likely women's favorite, though the sail change could reshuffle the order.

potentialContenders.name: Luuc van Opzeeland
potentialContenders.note: Paris 2024 bronze medalist who won the 2026 world and European titles. A likely men's contender.

potentialContenders.name: Emma Wilson
potentialContenders.note: Paris 2024 bronze medalist and 2025 world champion. She could be a factor if she reaches the 2028 team.

potentialContenders.name: Johan Søe
potentialContenders.note: Second at the 2026 Europeans and a medalist at the 2026 Worlds. A likely men's podium threat.

SAL03.blurb:
The kite finals are tomorrow, so this session is about who is putting themselves in position and who is running out of room. It is the third and last qualifying day for the kite fleet.

Windsurfing has its own tension. Marta Maggetti is the defending women's champion and won in Hyères in April 2026. Yet she was 18th overall after day four of that year's Worlds, a reminder that one bad stretch can bury even a champion.

Tom Reuveny, the Paris 2024 men's winner, has a four-year sponsorship behind his run to 2028. Valentin Bontus, the Paris kite champion, took bronze at the 2026 Worlds and will want to be among the leaders before the final.
SAL03.potentialContendersIntro: The contenders below are for windsurfing, where several Paris 2024 medalists and 2026 world medalists could appear. Their 2028 participation is not confirmed.

potentialContenders.name: Marta Maggetti
potentialContenders.note: Paris 2024 women's champion. She won in Hyères in 2026 but struggled at that year's Worlds, so her form is worth watching if she qualifies.

potentialContenders.name: Tom Reuveny
potentialContenders.note: Paris 2024 men's windsurfing champion with a four-year sponsorship that supports his 2028 campaign.

potentialContenders.name: Sharon Kantor
potentialContenders.note: Paris 2024 women's silver medalist who took silver again at the 2026 Worlds. A likely podium threat.

potentialContenders.name: Stella Bilger
potentialContenders.note: Bronze medalist at the 2026 iQFOiL Worlds. A rising name who could crash the women's top group.

SAL04.blurb:
The first sailing medals of the 2028 Games get decided in the kite finals, and the beach will be packed to see them. Because the races run close to shore, you can read every gybe and crash from the sand.

The men's storyline is Max Maeder against Gian Stragiotti. Maeder held off his training partner to win the 2026 Worlds, his third world title. Valentin Bontus, the Paris 2024 champion, is a threat, having taken bronze at that Worlds.

The women's side is just as sharp. Lauriane Nolot won her third world title in 2026 after Jessie Kampman crashed in the final. Daniela Moroz, a six-time world champion, could be chasing a first medal on home water.
SAL04.potentialContendersIntro: The kite finals will feature the top of the qualified fleet. These names are projections based on 2026 results and could change by 2028.

potentialContenders.name: Max Maeder
potentialContenders.note: Paris 2024 bronze medalist and 2026 world champion. A likely men's favorite if he qualifies.

potentialContenders.name: Gian Stragiotti
potentialContenders.note: Silver at the 2026 Worlds and 2026 European champion. He is Maeder's training partner and a possible gold challenger.

potentialContenders.name: Lauriane Nolot
potentialContenders.note: Paris 2024 silver medalist with three world titles. A likely women's favorite.

potentialContenders.name: Jessie Kampman
potentialContenders.note: 2025 world champion who took silver in 2026 after crashing in the final. She could be looking for redemption.

potentialContenders.name: Daniela Moroz
potentialContenders.note: Six-time world champion who placed fourth at the 2026 Worlds. A potential home medal threat if she makes the team.

SAL05.blurb:
It all ends in a few hours. These are the first Games medal races on the new iQFOiL sails, 8 square meters for the men and 7.3 for the women, and the format rewards nerve. At the 2026 Worlds, Tamar Steinberg won the women's title by taking the first race of the Grand Final to reach two match points.

Israel could have two medal threats on the women's side. Sharon Kantor, the Paris silver medalist, took silver at that Worlds. Marta Maggetti, the defending champion, is another name to watch.

On the men's side, Luuc van Opzeeland, the Paris bronze medalist and 2026 world champion, may face Tom Reuveny, the defending Games champion.
SAL05.potentialContendersIntro: These are the likeliest names for the windsurfing finals based on Paris 2024 and 2026 results. The 2028 fields are not set.

potentialContenders.name: Tamar Steinberg
potentialContenders.note: 2026 world and European champion. Projected as a leading women's contender if she qualifies.

potentialContenders.name: Sharon Kantor
potentialContenders.note: Paris 2024 silver medalist and 2026 Worlds silver medalist. A likely women's podium threat.

potentialContenders.name: Luuc van Opzeeland
potentialContenders.note: Paris 2024 bronze medalist and 2026 world champion. A likely men's favorite.

potentialContenders.name: Tom Reuveny
potentialContenders.note: Paris 2024 men's champion. He has a four-year sponsorship supporting his run toward 2028.

potentialContenders.name: Marta Maggetti
potentialContenders.note: Defending women's champion who won in Hyères in 2026. She could be a title threat if she gets back to form.

SAL06.blurb:
Almost a century after Los Angeles Harbor hosted sailing in 1932, the fleets are back on the same water. This is no resort backdrop. Container ships and tugs slide through San Pedro Bay while the one-person dinghies tack in front of them.

Day one of the qualifying series is about reputations being tested. The men's ILCA 7 world title has changed hands in each of the last two years, from Willem Wiersema in 2025 to Hungary's Jonatán Vadnai in 2026. No medals are handed out today, but a bad opening day can haunt a sailor all week.

Watch for American Charlotte Rose, the 2026 ILCA 6 world champion, if she makes the home team.
SAL06.potentialContendersIntro: This session covers the men's ILCA 7 and women's ILCA 6. 2028 rosters aren't set, so these names are likely contenders based on recent form.

potentialContenders.name: Matt Wearn
potentialContenders.note: Paris 2024 gold medalist in the men's one-person dinghy. If he qualifies, he is the fleet's reference point.

potentialContenders.name: Willem Wiersema
potentialContenders.note: Won the 2025 ILCA 7 world title in Qingdao on 11 points, one clear of Pavlos Kontides.

potentialContenders.name: Jonatán Vadnai
potentialContenders.note: Won the 2026 ILCA 7 worlds in Dún Laoghaire, Hungary's first title in the event. A strong candidate if he qualifies.

potentialContenders.name: Charlotte Rose
potentialContenders.note: Won the 2026 ILCA 6 worlds on Dublin Bay, the first non-European winner in 20 years. A possible home favorite.

potentialContenders.name: Louise Cervera
potentialContenders.note: 2025 ILCA 6 world champion, crowned after four windless days in Qingdao left only a few races.

SAL07.blurb:
Two new classes hit the water today, and they could hardly look more different. The Nacra 17 catamarans fly on foils, and the 2025 worlds medal races were sailed at more than 20 knots in rough seas. The 470 is a two-person dinghy where tactics rule.

Britain's Martin Wrigley and Bettine Harris led most of the final race at the 2025 470 worlds and still finished third. Nothing is settled until the last leg.

The men's and women's one-person dinghy fleets sail their second day too, so four fleets share the harbor. Watch from the shore and you can follow the multihulls across the whole bay.
SAL07.potentialContendersIntro: The marquee events here are the mixed Nacra 17 and mixed 470. Starting lists for 2028 aren't known, so these are projected contenders based on recent worlds results.

potentialContenders.name: John Gimson / Anna Burnet
potentialContenders.note: Won the 2025 Nacra 17 worlds, their third world title, then took bronze in 2026. Could be a contender if they qualify.

potentialContenders.name: Gianluigi Ugolini / Maria Giubilei
potentialContenders.note: Finished just behind Gimson and Burnet at the 2025 Nacra 17 worlds. Italy won Nacra 17 gold at Paris 2024.

potentialContenders.name: Willemijn Offerman / Scipio Houtman
potentialContenders.note: Took bronze at the 2025 Nacra 17 worlds, their first world championship podium. A pair on the rise.

potentialContenders.name: Jordi Xammar / Marta Cardona
potentialContenders.note: Won the 2025 470 world title in Gdynia, passing Britain on the final leg.

potentialContenders.name: Martin Wrigley / Bettine Harris
potentialContenders.note: Led most of the final race at the 2025 470 worlds before finishing third. Possible revenge-minded contenders.

SAL08.blurb:
The skiffs arrive, and with them the sharpest form guide of the week. Spain swept both the 49er and 49erFX world titles in 2025. In 2026 New Zealand's Seb Menzies and George Lee Rush and Norway's Pia Dahl Andersen and Nora Edland took them, the Norwegians by a single point.

Medals are still three days away, so today is about reading the pecking order. Diego Botín and Florian Trittel, the Paris 2024 gold medalists, needed years of near-misses to win their first 49er worlds.

The dinghy, mixed 470 and Nacra 17 series all carry on around them, giving the harbor a full-fleet feel.
SAL08.potentialContendersIntro: The headline events are the men's 49er and women's 49erFX. 2028 entries aren't confirmed, so these are projected contenders based on 2025 and 2026 worlds form.

potentialContenders.name: Diego Botín / Florian Trittel
potentialContenders.note: Paris 2024 men's skiff gold medalists and 2025 49er world champions. If they stay together, they are the pair to chase.

potentialContenders.name: Seb Menzies / George Lee Rush
potentialContenders.note: Won the 2026 49er worlds in Quiberon. Menzies also co-helms Emirates Team New Zealand's America's Cup boats.

potentialContenders.name: Bart Lambriex / Floris van de Werken
potentialContenders.note: Three-time 49er world champions, with silver in 2025 and bronze in 2026.

potentialContenders.name: Pia Dahl Andersen / Nora Edland
potentialContenders.note: Won the 2026 49erFX worlds by one point over Spain.

potentialContenders.name: Paula Barceló / María Cantero
potentialContenders.note: 2025 49erFX world champions and 2026 runners-up. A likely threat if they qualify.

SAL09.blurb:
One point. That separated Willem Wiersema from Pavlos Kontides at the 2025 ILCA 7 worlds, and the margin at the top of this fleet rarely widens. Today the one-person dinghy medals are decided in the harbor at San Pedro.

The women's fleet carries its own storyline. American Charlotte Rose won the 2026 world title after leading into the final series. If she is on the 2028 team, a home sailor in medal contention will pull the shore crowd to its feet.

Skiffs sail their second day and the mixed fleets their third, so the water stays busy around the finals.
SAL09.potentialContendersIntro: The medals at stake are the men's ILCA 7 and women's ILCA 6. Qualification for 2028 is still underway, so the names below are projections based on recent results.

potentialContenders.name: Matt Wearn
potentialContenders.note: Reigning champion from Paris 2024, ahead of Kontides and Peschiera. Could return to defend.

potentialContenders.name: Willem Wiersema
potentialContenders.note: Won the 2025 ILCA 7 worlds by a single point over Kontides.

potentialContenders.name: Jonatán Vadnai
potentialContenders.note: Fourth at the 2025 worlds, then 2026 world champion. Hungary's first title in the event.

potentialContenders.name: Charlotte Rose
potentialContenders.note: 2026 ILCA 6 world champion who led into the final series. A potential home contender.

potentialContenders.name: Marit Bouwmeester
potentialContenders.note: Paris 2024 women's gold medalist. Her 2028 plans aren't confirmed, but she would be a favorite if she returns.

SAL10.blurb:
Britain's Martin Wrigley and Bettine Harris led most of the final race at the 2025 470 worlds. Then Spain's Jordi Xammar and Marta Cardona overtook them on the last leg. If that rematch lands here, the finish may come down to the final stretch again.

The Nacra 17 final looks different. Britain's John Gimson and Anna Burnet won their third world title in 2025, and Italy, Paris 2024's champion nation, was right behind them. The 2025 medal races were sailed on foils at more than 20 knots in rough seas.

The skiffs sail their third day too, setting up Friday's last medals.
SAL10.potentialContendersIntro: The mixed 470 and mixed Nacra 17 medals are decided in this session. 2028 pairings aren't set, so these are projected contenders based on recent worlds.

potentialContenders.name: Jordi Xammar / Marta Cardona
potentialContenders.note: 2025 470 world champions who passed Britain on the final leg in Gdynia.

potentialContenders.name: Martin Wrigley / Bettine Harris
potentialContenders.note: Third at the 2025 470 worlds after leading most of the final race. They have unfinished business.

potentialContenders.name: John Gimson / Anna Burnet
potentialContenders.note: Won the 2025 Nacra 17 worlds, their third title in the class, and took bronze in 2026.

potentialContenders.name: Gianluigi Ugolini / Maria Giubilei
potentialContenders.note: Runners-up to Gimson and Burnet at the 2025 Nacra 17 worlds, in a country that won Nacra 17 gold at Paris 2024.

potentialContenders.name: Brin Liddell / Rhiannan Brown
potentialContenders.note: Fourth at the 2025 Nacra 17 worlds, their career best. Could push for a medal.

SAL11.blurb:
One point decided the 2026 49erFX world title, and Norway's Pia Dahl Andersen and Nora Edland took it by winning the final race. Expect that kind of knife edge for the last medals of the sailing regatta, in the shortest session of the week at three hours.

In the men's fleet, Spain's Diego Botín and Florian Trittel are Paris 2024 champions and 2025 world champions. New Zealand's Seb Menzies and George Lee Rush beat the field at the 2026 worlds after a close final race. Menzies also co-helms Emirates Team New Zealand's America's Cup boats.

The Netherlands' Bart Lambriex and Floris van de Werken, three-time world champions, would love to add a Games medal.
SAL11.potentialContendersIntro: The final medals are the men's 49er and women's 49erFX. 2028 participation isn't confirmed, so these are projected contenders based on recent worlds form.

potentialContenders.name: Diego Botín / Florian Trittel
potentialContenders.note: Paris 2024 gold medalists and 2025 world champions. They're the benchmark if they stay together.

potentialContenders.name: Seb Menzies / George Lee Rush
potentialContenders.note: 2026 49er world champions. New Zealand took silver in this event at Paris 2024.

potentialContenders.name: Bart Lambriex / Floris van de Werken
potentialContenders.note: Three-time world champions, with silver in 2025 and bronze in 2026.

potentialContenders.name: Pia Dahl Andersen / Nora Edland
potentialContenders.note: 2026 49erFX world champions by one point, winning the final race.

potentialContenders.name: Paula Barceló / María Cantero
potentialContenders.note: 2025 49erFX world champions and 2026 runners-up. A likely medal threat.

SHO01.blurb:
One point. That was the gap between Sheng Lihao and his Chinese teammate Ma Sihan at the 2026 world championship, 254.1 to 253.1. Air rifle finals are built to expose exactly that kind of margin.

The temporary range sits inside the Long Beach Convention Center, which hosted fencing in 1984. The room goes quiet the way few arenas do. A shooter holds, a pellet lands, and the scoreboard decides who gets to breathe.

The women's side has its own anchor in Korea's Ban Hyojin, the Paris 2024 champion and a world champion in both 2025 and 2026. China's Han Jiayu chased her to within a point in Doha. Two finals, one long Saturday.
SHO01.potentialContendersIntro: Contenders are for the men's and women's 10m air rifle finals. Doha results are confirmed; who actually qualifies for 2028 is projection.

potentialContenders.name: Sheng Lihao
potentialContenders.note: Paris 2024 champion who also won the 2026 world title with 254.1. Likely the man to beat if he makes the team.

potentialContenders.name: Ma Sihan
potentialContenders.note: Took silver in Doha, one point behind Sheng. A strong contender if China sends him.

potentialContenders.name: Ban Hyojin
potentialContenders.note: Paris 2024 champion and world champion in 2025 and 2026, with a 2028 quota place already secured for Korea. A favorite for gold.

potentialContenders.name: Han Jiayu
potentialContenders.note: Women's silver medalist in Doha with 252.2, less than a point behind Ban. A likely threat to the title.

potentialContenders.name: Miran Maricic
potentialContenders.note: Won the Doha bronze and earned a quota place for Croatia. A possible medal threat if he qualifies.

SHO02.blurb:
Three-tenths of a point. That was Jiang Ranxin's edge over teammate Yao Qianxun in the women's air pistol final at the 2026 worlds, 242.4 to 242.1. Pistol shooting really does come down to that.

Shooters stand 10 meters from the target, one arm extended, almost motionless. In Long Beach you watch from beside the marked lanes. The only sounds are a snap, a pause, and a score appearing.

Keep an eye on India's Manu Bhaker, the Paris 2024 bronze medalist who finished fifth in Doha and missed a quota there. If she finds her way back, this crowd will lean in with her.
SHO02.potentialContendersIntro: Contenders are for the men's and women's 10m air pistol finals. Doha results are confirmed; 2028 participation is projection.

potentialContenders.name: Hu Kai
potentialContenders.note: Won the 2026 world title in Doha with 243.9 and is a likely gold contender for China.

potentialContenders.name: Jaypal Malviya
potentialContenders.note: Silver in Doha with 242.2, earning India's first 2028 shooting quota place. A possible medal threat.

potentialContenders.name: Jiang Ranxin
potentialContenders.note: Won the 2026 women's world title with 242.4, by just 0.3. A likely contender if selected.

potentialContenders.name: Yao Qianxun
potentialContenders.note: Silver in Doha on 242.1, and part of China's bronze-medal mixed team. A projected podium threat.

potentialContenders.name: Manu Bhaker
potentialContenders.note: Paris 2024 bronze medalist who qualified third in Doha but finished fifth, missing a quota. A redemption story if she makes the team.

SHO03.blurb:
Vincent Hancock, if he makes the team, arrives as the home favorite and a curious underdog: his ISSF profile had him 16th in the men's skeet world rankings late in 2026. Then he hit all 36 in a World Cup final at Lonato and set a world record.

Day one is where form gets tested. In Doha, four men were still perfect at 50 after the opening day. The women's field has Samantha Simonton, the 2025 world champion, and Paris champion Francisca Crovetto.

Sit behind the stations, hear the call and the crack, and watch for the shooters who never drop a bird. Nobody wins gold today, but plenty lose it.
SHO03.potentialContendersIntro: This session covers both men's and women's skeet. Hancock, Simonton and Crovetto are projections, since 2028 rosters are not set, while Hansen's world title and Paris results are confirmed.

potentialContenders.name: Vincent Hancock
potentialContenders.note: Paris 2024 men's skeet champion and reigning world champion. He set a world record of 36 in a 2026 World Cup final and has said he wants another gold at home, though he still has to make the U.S. team.

potentialContenders.name: Jesper Hansen
potentialContenders.note: Won the 2026 world title in Doha and earned Denmark a men's quota place. He was one of four men perfect after day one there.

potentialContenders.name: Samantha Simonton
potentialContenders.note: 2025 women's skeet world champion and winner of the 2026 U.S. Fall Skeet Selection Match. A likely contender if she makes the team.

potentialContenders.name: Francisca Crovetto
potentialContenders.note: Reigning women's skeet champion from Paris 2024. She was entered in the 2026 Doha World Championship field and could return to defend.

potentialContenders.name: Amber Rutter
potentialContenders.note: Paris 2024 silver medalist. She was part of the Great Britain team that took women's skeet team silver in Doha, so she is a likely contender if selected.

SHO04.blurb:
Forget the old gold-medal match. At the 2028 Games the top four qualifying teams in the mixed events shoot one combined final, and the teams are eliminated as it goes. One bad series can end a medal run.

Doha previewed how thin the margins get. South Korea qualified first in air rifle with 634.4, then was eliminated 0.8 points behind China's second team and took bronze. China's first team won with 506.1.

Two shooters share one score, so there is nowhere to hide. Pay attention to how each partner reacts after a weak shot.
SHO04.potentialContendersIntro: Contenders are national teams for the mixed team 10m air rifle and air pistol events. Results from Doha and Paris 2024 are confirmed; the 2028 pairings are projection.

potentialContenders.name: China
potentialContenders.note: Won air rifle and air pistol mixed team titles in Doha. A likely favorite in both events.

potentialContenders.name: South Korea
potentialContenders.note: Ban Hyojin and Park Hajun qualified first in Doha air rifle and took bronze. Could be a gold threat in the new format.

potentialContenders.name: Iran
potentialContenders.note: Haniyeh Rostamiyan and Vahid Golkhandan won air pistol silver in Doha. A possible medal threat.

potentialContenders.name: Serbia
potentialContenders.note: Won Paris 2024 mixed team air pistol gold. Could return as a contender if they qualify.

SHO05.blurb:
Thirty-six targets, thirty-six hits. Vincent Hancock did it in a World Cup final at Lonato in July 2026, a world record, and a home Games could be the place he tries to do it again.

He won't have the stage to himself. Denmark's Jesper Hansen took the 2026 world title by beating Egypt's Azmy Mehelba 16-15 in a shoot-off, and China's Jiang Yiting is the woman to catch after her Doha win. Samantha Simonton and Francisca Crovetto will have plenty to say too.

The final now seats eight shooters instead of six, so the ladder runs longer. One miss can swing a medal, and you'll feel the crowd hold its breath before every call.
SHO05.potentialContendersIntro: This session decides both the men's and women's skeet medals. Hancock, Simonton and Crovetto are projected 2028 contenders if they make their teams, while Hansen's and Jiang's world titles are confirmed.

potentialContenders.name: Vincent Hancock
potentialContenders.note: Paris 2024 gold medalist and 2026 World Cup record-setter with a perfect 36 in the final. He did not shoot the Doha worlds and is not yet a lock for the U.S. team, since Christian Elliott beat him in the fall selection match.

potentialContenders.name: Jesper Hansen
potentialContenders.note: 2026 world champion, winning a 16-15 shoot-off over Egypt's Azmy Mehelba after both hit 34. A projected medal threat.

potentialContenders.name: Jiang Yiting
potentialContenders.note: Won the 2026 women's skeet world title with 34 and the 2025 World Cup Final. She also took mixed team bronze at Paris 2024 and could be the woman to beat.

potentialContenders.name: Samantha Simonton
potentialContenders.note: 2025 world champion and winner of the 2026 U.S. Fall Skeet Selection Match. A home-crowd favorite if she makes the team.

potentialContenders.name: Francisca Crovetto
potentialContenders.note: Paris 2024 champion who beat Amber Rutter and Austen Smith. She could return to defend her title.

SHO06.blurb:
Two-tenths of a point. Liu Yukun beat India's Aishwary Pratap Singh Tomar 467.1 to 466.9 at the 2025 worlds, and the new final format won't loosen margins like that.

Three positions used to mean a long march through kneeling, prone and standing. Now kneeling and prone merge into one timed phase, and standing plus elimination settle the medals. Standing is where nerves show: the rifle drifts and the body gets in the way.

China's Zhang Changhong set a final world record of 363.0 in Hangzhou and could be the man to catch. It's a morning session, and the beach volleyball and aquatics venues are a short walk away for the afternoon.
SHO06.potentialContendersIntro: Contenders are for the men's 50m rifle 3 positions. Paris 2024 and world championship results are confirmed; 2028 selection is projection.

potentialContenders.name: Liu Yukun
potentialContenders.note: Paris 2024 champion and 2025 world champion with 467.1. A likely favorite if he makes the team.

potentialContenders.name: Zhang Changhong
potentialContenders.note: Set a final world record of 363.0 at the 2026 Hangzhou World Cup and won two World Cups in 2026. A strong gold contender.

potentialContenders.name: Aishwary Pratap Singh Tomar
potentialContenders.note: Finished 0.2 behind Liu at the 2025 worlds. A possible medal threat if he qualifies.

potentialContenders.name: Romain Aufrere
potentialContenders.note: Took bronze at the 2025 worlds and has been a regular in major finals. A potential podium contender.

SHO07.blurb:
Aleksandra Stojadinovic needed her last shot in Doha and she delivered: 358.4 to 357.7 over South Korea's Oh Sehee, a first senior world title at age 22.

That tells you about this event. Women's three positions is a slow burn in which nobody can afford a loose shot, and the new final strips it down to a standing finish where nerves matter most.

There is a home storyline too. Sagen Maddalena of the USA took silver at Paris 2024 behind Switzerland's Chiara Leone, and if she makes the team, a Long Beach crowd will have a local medal threat to cheer.
SHO07.potentialContendersIntro: Contenders are for the women's 50m rifle 3 positions. Results from Doha and Paris 2024 are confirmed; 2028 selection is projection.

potentialContenders.name: Aleksandra Stojadinovic
potentialContenders.note: 2026 world champion at 22, winning with her final shot. Likely a gold contender.

potentialContenders.name: Oh Sehee
potentialContenders.note: Silver in Doha, 0.7 behind Stojadinovic. A projected medal threat.

potentialContenders.name: Chiara Leone
potentialContenders.note: Paris 2024 champion who finished fifth in Doha. Could be back in contention.

potentialContenders.name: Sagen Maddalena
potentialContenders.note: Paris 2024 silver medalist. A possible home-crowd favorite if she makes the team.

potentialContenders.name: Misaki Nobata
potentialContenders.note: Doha bronze medalist with 348.2, earning a quota place for Japan. A potential podium contender.

SHO08.blurb:
The reigning champion shot 113 and finished 78th. That was Nathan Hales at the 2025 World Championship in Athens, a reminder that trap humbles everyone, even a man who missed only two of 50 in the Paris final.

That's the appeal of day one: a deep field, no medals handed out, and every station a chance for a favorite to wobble. Croatia's Josip Glasnovic and Spain's Mar Molne Magrina arrive as world champions, and American Will Hinton won the 2025 World Cup Final.

Come for the depth. You see the whole field up close in the green parkland of Whittier Narrows, with eight final spots on the line.
SHO08.potentialContendersIntro: This session covers both women's and men's trap. The names below are projections based on 2025 results, since 2028 rosters are not set.

potentialContenders.name: Josip Glasnovic
potentialContenders.note: 2025 men's trap world champion in a field of 133, and a leader of the Croatian team that won the 2025 team title. A likely contender if he qualifies.

potentialContenders.name: Will Hinton
potentialContenders.note: Won the 2025 World Cup Final in Doha and led the U.S. to team silver at the 2025 worlds. Could be the home crowd's best men's trap hope.

potentialContenders.name: Mar Molne Magrina
potentialContenders.note: 2025 women's trap world champion, ahead of Silvana Stanco and Sandra Bernal. A projected favorite if she makes the team.

potentialContenders.name: Silvana Stanco
potentialContenders.note: Paris 2024 silver medalist, 2025 world silver medalist and 2025 World Cup Final winner. A consistent contender if she qualifies.

potentialContenders.name: Nathan Hales
potentialContenders.note: Paris 2024 gold medalist who shot just 113 in Athens in 2025. Whether he qualifies and returns to form is a storyline to watch.

SHO09.blurb:
Clement Bessaguet shot 594 in qualification at Osijek in May 2026, a world record in a discipline where a few misses end a run. Rapid fire pistol is the sport's strangest rhythm: five targets, seconds to hit them, the arm raised and dropped like a metronome.

This is the first half of the story. The men shoot stage 1 of rapid fire, and the women work through the precision stage of 25m pistol qualification. No medals are decided, but both fields start sorting themselves.

Come for value and a close look at the shooters. India's women's team won gold in Doha, and a long day in the hall lets you see why.
SHO09.potentialContendersIntro: Contenders are for men's 25m rapid fire pistol and women's 25m pistol. Recent results are confirmed; who appears in 2028 is projection.

potentialContenders.name: Clement Bessaguet
potentialContenders.note: Holds the 594 qualification world record and took silver in Doha. A likely contender if he qualifies.

potentialContenders.name: Florian Peter
potentialContenders.note: Won the 2026 world title in Doha, one hit ahead of Bessaguet. Germany has a quota place.

potentialContenders.name: Li Yuehong
potentialContenders.note: Paris 2024 champion. Could return as a medal threat if China selects him.

potentialContenders.name: Yang Jiin
potentialContenders.note: Paris 2024 champion and world champion in 2025 and 2026. The projected favorite for the women's 25m pistol.

potentialContenders.name: Esha Singh
potentialContenders.note: Top-scored for India's winning team in Doha with 590. Could be a standout in the precision stage.

SHO10.blurb:
Guatemala's first gold medal came from Adriana Ruano's trap win in Paris. If she returns, she comes back as a champion with a target on her back.

The men's side could bring back Nathan Hales, whose Paris final missed just two of 50 for a Games record and gave Britain its first trap gold since 1968. Croatia's world champion Josip Glasnovic and America's Will Hinton are likely to push him.

The final now has eight shooters instead of six, so the closing stretch runs longer. You'll watch each one step up in turn as the clays fly across the Whittier Narrows fields.
SHO10.potentialContendersIntro: This session decides both women's and men's trap medals. Ruano's and Hales's Paris titles are confirmed, while their 2028 spots and the other names are projections.

potentialContenders.name: Adriana Ruano
potentialContenders.note: Paris 2024 champion who won Guatemala's first gold medal. She could return to defend if she qualifies.

potentialContenders.name: Nathan Hales
potentialContenders.note: Paris 2024 gold medalist with a Games-record final, but he finished 78th at the 2025 worlds. His form is the question if he qualifies.

potentialContenders.name: Josip Glasnovic
potentialContenders.note: 2025 men's trap world champion, ahead of Spain's Andres Garcia and India's Zoravar Singh Sandhu. A likely medal threat.

potentialContenders.name: Will Hinton
potentialContenders.note: Won the 2025 World Cup Final in Doha and led the U.S. to team silver at the 2025 worlds. A home contender if he makes the team.

potentialContenders.name: Silvana Stanco
potentialContenders.note: Paris 2024 silver medalist who won the 2025 World Cup Final and took world silver. Spain's Mar Molne Magrina, the 2025 world champion, is her main rival.

SHO11.blurb:
Forty-four hits. That is Yang Jiin's final world record from Doha, and it frames the women's 25m pistol final, where every shot is a hit or a miss. She won at Paris 2024 and was world champion in 2025 and again in 2026.

The men's rapid fire pistol final changes too, growing from six shooters to eight, so more names, more shoot-off possibilities, and more chances for an upset. Germany's Florian Peter beat France's Clement Bessaguet by one hit in Doha.

This is the long day in the hall. Two medal events and two stories across a single Sunday, in a convention center where the shooting doesn't stop until evening.
SHO11.potentialContendersIntro: Contenders are for the men's 25m rapid fire pistol final and women's 25m pistol final. Results from Doha and Paris 2024 are confirmed; the 2028 field is projection.

potentialContenders.name: Yang Jiin
potentialContenders.note: Paris 2024 champion and the 2026 world champion with a final world record of 44 hits. A clear favorite if she makes the team.

potentialContenders.name: Trinh Thu Vinh
potentialContenders.note: Won silver in Doha with 43 hits, one behind Yang, and earned a quota place. A likely medal contender.

potentialContenders.name: Florian Peter
potentialContenders.note: Won the 2026 rapid fire world title with 33 hits. Could be a gold contender.

potentialContenders.name: Clement Bessaguet
potentialContenders.note: Silver in Doha by one hit and 2025 world champion. A projected medal threat.

potentialContenders.name: Li Yuehong
potentialContenders.note: Paris 2024 men's rapid fire champion. Could return to defend if China selects him.

SHO12.blurb:
Four teams. One final. All shooting at the same time, with no separate bronze match to catch anyone who slips. That is the new format for mixed team trap, built so every contender stays in the fight until the end.

Italy won the one-time mixed skeet title in Paris, and Massimo Fabbrizi and Alessia Iezzi won the 2025 mixed trap world title. San Marino's Gian Marco Berti and Alessandra Perilli took silver after a four-way shoot-off. Walton Eller and Ava Downs gave the USA bronze, Downs's first world medal at age 20.

A home crowd, a new event, and a final with nowhere to hide.
SHO12.potentialContendersIntro: Mixed team trap replaces mixed team skeet for 2028, and no quota places were awarded for it in Doha. These teams are based on 2025 world results, and 2028 pairings are not set.

potentialContenders.name: Italy
